  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ElementarySubgroup
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block

/-!
# Block unipotent matrices

Rectangular upper and lower unitriangular block matrices in `GL (α ⊕ β)` and
their membership in the elementary subgroup via `Matrix.induction_on'`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix
namespace GeneralLinearGroup
namespace BlockElementary

open Matrix

variable {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Upper unitriangular `[[1, A],[0,1]]`. -/
def upperUnit (A : Matrix α β R) : GL (α ⊕ β) R where
  val := fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R)
  inv := fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-A) (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R)
  val_inv := by
    calc fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-A) (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R)
        = fromBlocks
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) + A * (0 : Matrix β α R))
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (-A) + A * (1 : Matrix β β R))
            ((0 : Matrix β α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (0 : Matrix β α R))
            ((0 : Matrix β α R) * (-A) +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
          rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) := by simp
      _ = 1 := fromBlocks_one
  inv_val := by
    calc fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-A) (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R)
        = fromBlocks
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) + (-A) * (0 : Matrix β α R))
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * A + (-A) * (1 : Matrix β β R))
            ((0 : Matrix β α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (0 : Matrix β α R))
            ((0 : Matrix β α R) * A +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
          rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) := by simp
      _ = 1 := fromBlocks_one

@[simp]
lemma coe_upperUnit (A : Matrix α β R) :
    (↑(upperUnit A) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) =
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem upperUnit_zero : upperUnit (0 : Matrix α β R) = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [coe_upperUnit, fromBlocks_one]

theorem upperUnit_add (A B : Matrix α β R) :
    upperUnit (A + B) = upperUnit A * upperUnit B := by
  have h_prod :
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) B (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) =
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (A + B) (0 : Matrix β α R)
          (1 : Matrix β β R) := by
    calc fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) B (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R)
        = fromBlocks
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) + A * (0 : Matrix β α R))
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * B + A * (1 : Matrix β β R))
            ((0 : Matrix β α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (0 : Matrix β α R))
            ((0 : Matrix β α R) * B +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
          rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B + A) (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) := by simp
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (A + B) (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) := by rw [add_comm]
  apply Units.ext
  calc (↑(upperUnit (A + B)) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R)
      = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (A + B) (0 : Matrix β α R)
          (1 : Matrix β β R) := rfl
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) B (0 : Matrix β α R)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) := h_prod.symm
    _ = (↑(upperUnit A) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) *
          (↑(upperUnit B) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
        rw [coe_upperUnit, coe_upperUnit]
    _ = (↑(upperUnit A * upperUnit B) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := rfl

theorem upperUnit_single (i : α) (j : β) (a : R) :
    upperUnit (Matrix.single i j a) =
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary
        (Sum.inl (α := α) (β := β) i) (Sum.inr (α := α) (β := β) j)
        Sum.inl_ne_inr a := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext x y
  rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y <;>
    simp [coe_upperUnit,
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_elementary, fromBlocks,
      Matrix.single, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.add_apply]

/-- Lower unitriangular `[[1,0],[A,1]]` with `A : Matrix β α R`. -/
def lowerUnit (A : Matrix β α R) : GL (α ⊕ β) R where
  val := fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A (1 : Matrix β β R)
  inv := fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (-A) (1 : Matrix β β R)
  val_inv := by
    calc fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A
            (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (-A)
            (1 : Matrix β β R)
        = fromBlocks
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) +
              (0 : Matrix α β R) * (-A))
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (0 : Matrix α β R) +
              (0 : Matrix α β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R))
            (A * (1 : Matrix α α R) + (1 : Matrix β β R) * (-A))
            (A * (0 : Matrix α β R) +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
          rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) := by simp
      _ = 1 := fromBlocks_one
  inv_val := by
    calc fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (-A)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A
            (1 : Matrix β β R)
        = fromBlocks
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) +
              (0 : Matrix α β R) * A)
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (0 : Matrix α β R) +
              (0 : Matrix α β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R))
            ((-A) * (1 : Matrix α α R) + (1 : Matrix β β R) * A)
            ((-A) * (0 : Matrix α β R) +
              (1 : Matrix β β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
          rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) := by simp
      _ = 1 := fromBlocks_one

@[simp]
lemma coe_lowerUnit (A : Matrix β α R) :
    (↑(lowerUnit A) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) =
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A (1 : Matrix β β R) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem lowerUnit_zero : lowerUnit (0 : Matrix β α R) = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [coe_lowerUnit, fromBlocks_one]

theorem lowerUnit_add (A B : Matrix β α R) :
    lowerUnit (A + B) = lowerUnit A * lowerUnit B := by
  have h_prod :
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A
          (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) B
          (1 : Matrix β β R) =
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (A + B)
          (1 : Matrix β β R) := by
    calc fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A
            (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) B
            (1 : Matrix β β R)
        = fromBlocks
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (1 : Matrix α α R) +
              (0 : Matrix α β R) * B)
            ((1 : Matrix α α R) * (0 : Matrix α β R) +
              (0 : Matrix α β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R))
            (A * (1 : Matrix α α R) + (1 : Matrix β β R) * B)
            (A * (0 : Matrix α β R) + (1 : Matrix β β R) * (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
          rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
      _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (A + B)
            (1 : Matrix β β R) := by simp
  apply Units.ext
  calc (↑(lowerUnit (A + B)) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R)
      = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) (A + B)
          (1 : Matrix β β R) := rfl
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) A
            (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) B
            (1 : Matrix β β R) := h_prod.symm
    _ = (↑(lowerUnit A) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) *
          (↑(lowerUnit B) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
        rw [coe_lowerUnit, coe_lowerUnit]
    _ = (↑(lowerUnit A * lowerUnit B) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := rfl

theorem lowerUnit_single (i : β) (j : α) (a : R) :
    lowerUnit (Matrix.single i j a) =
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary
        (Sum.inr (α := α) (β := β) i) (Sum.inl (α := α) (β := β) j)
        Sum.inr_ne_inl a := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext x y
  rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y <;>
    simp [coe_lowerUnit,
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_elementary, fromBlocks,
      Matrix.single, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.add_apply]

theorem upperUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup (A : Matrix α β R) :
    upperUnit A ∈
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R := by
  let P : Matrix α β R → Prop := fun M =>
    upperUnit M ∈ _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R
  have h_zero : P 0 := by
    dsimp [P]
    rw [upperUnit_zero]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  have h_add : ∀ p q, P p → P q → P (p + q) := by
    intro p q hp hq
    dsimp [P] at hp hq ⊢
    have h_eq : upperUnit (p + q) = upperUnit p * upperUnit q :=
      upperUnit_add p q
    rw [h_eq]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hp hq
  have h_single : ∀ i j a, P (Matrix.single i j a) := by
    intro i j a
    dsimp [P]
    rw [upperUnit_single]
    exact _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup
      _ _ _ _
  exact Matrix.induction_on' A h_zero h_add h_single

theorem lowerUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup (A : Matrix β α R) :
    lowerUnit A ∈
      _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R := by
  let P : Matrix β α R → Prop := fun M =>
    lowerUnit M ∈ _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ β) R
  have h_zero : P 0 := by
    dsimp [P]
    rw [lowerUnit_zero]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  have h_add : ∀ p q, P p → P q → P (p + q) := by
    intro p q hp hq
    dsimp [P] at hp hq ⊢
    have h_eq : lowerUnit (p + q) = lowerUnit p * lowerUnit q :=
      lowerUnit_add p q
    rw [h_eq]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hp hq
  have h_single : ∀ i j a, P (Matrix.single i j a) := by
    intro i j a
    dsimp [P]
    rw [lowerUnit_single]
    exact _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup
      _ _ _ _
  exact Matrix.induction_on' A h_zero h_add h_single

/-- Alternating product of block unipotents in `GL (α ⊕ β) R`.

Orientation: `Sum.inl A` uses `upperUnit` as `[[1, A],[0,1]]` and
`Sum.inr C` uses `lowerUnit` as `[[1,0],[C,1]]`. Multiplication order is
`List.prod` of the `Sum.elim`-image, so the head factor multiplies on the
left: `blockAltProd (a :: L) = (Sum.elim upperUnit lowerUnit a) *
blockAltProd L`. Works over any `[Ring R]` with `[Fintype α] [Fintype β]`;
empty list is `1` and zero-dimensional `α` or `β` yields trivial blocks
definitionally. This is a pure matrix recurrence; no elementary-subgroup,
kernel, pivot, alternation, or C3 claim is made. -/
noncomputable def blockAltProd
    (L : List (Matrix α β R ⊕ Matrix β α R)) : GL (α ⊕ β) R :=
  (L.map (Sum.elim upperUnit lowerUnit)).prod

@[simp]
theorem blockAltProd_nil :
    blockAltProd ([] : List (Matrix α β R ⊕ Matrix β α R)) = 1 := rfl

theorem blockAltProd_cons_inl
    (A : Matrix α β R) (L : List (Matrix α β R ⊕ Matrix β α R)) :
    (↑(blockAltProd (Sum.inl A :: L)) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) =
      fromBlocks
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁ +
          A * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂ +
          A * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂) := by
  have h_prod : blockAltProd (Sum.inl A :: L) = upperUnit A * blockAltProd L := by
    simp [blockAltProd]
  calc (↑(blockAltProd (Sum.inl A :: L)) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R)
      = (↑(upperUnit A * blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
        rw [h_prod]
    _ = (↑(upperUnit A) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) *
        (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := rfl
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R)
          (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
        rw [coe_upperUnit]
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) A (0 : Matrix β α R)
          (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        fromBlocks ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁)
          ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂)
          ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
          ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂) := by
        conv => lhs; rw [(Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks
            (M := (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R))).symm]
    _ = fromBlocks
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁ +
          A * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂ +
          A * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂) := by
        rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
        simp

theorem blockAltProd_cons_inr
    (C : Matrix β α R) (L : List (Matrix α β R ⊕ Matrix β α R)) :
    (↑(blockAltProd (Sum.inr C :: L)) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) =
      fromBlocks
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂)
        (C * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁ +
          (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
        (C * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂ +
          (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂) := by
  have h_prod : blockAltProd (Sum.inr C :: L) = lowerUnit C * blockAltProd L := by
    simp [blockAltProd]
  calc (↑(blockAltProd (Sum.inr C :: L)) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R)
      = (↑(lowerUnit C * blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
        rw [h_prod]
    _ = (↑(lowerUnit C) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) *
        (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := rfl
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) C
          (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
        rw [coe_lowerUnit]
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R) C
          (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        fromBlocks ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁)
          ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂)
          ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
          ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂) := by
        conv => lhs; rw [(Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks
            (M := (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R))).symm]
    _ = fromBlocks
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁)
        ((↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂)
        (C * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₁ +
          (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₁)
        (C * (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₁₂ +
          (↑(blockAltProd L) : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R).toBlocks₂₂) := by
        rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
        simp

end BlockElementary
end GeneralLinearGroup
end Matrix

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Stabilization
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basis

/-!
# Elementary matrices for `GL` over an arbitrary ring

`elementary i j a` is `1 + single i j a` with `i ≠ j`; its inverse is
`1 + single i j (-a)`. Works for noncommutative rings.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix

variable {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Elementary matrix `E_{ij}(a) = 1 + single i j a`, `i ≠ j`. -/
def elementary (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) : GL n R where
  val := 1 + Matrix.single i j a
  inv := 1 + Matrix.single i j (-a)
  val_inv := by
    simp [mul_add, add_mul, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hij.symm, ← single_neg]
  inv_val := by
    simp [mul_add, add_mul, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hij.symm, ← single_neg]

@[simp]
lemma coe_elementary (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    (↑(elementary i j hij a) : Matrix n n R) = 1 + Matrix.single i j a :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma elementary_zero (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    elementary i j hij (0 : R) = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp

@[simp]
lemma elementary_mul_same (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a b : R) :
    elementary i j hij a * elementary i j hij b = elementary i j hij (a + b) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [mul_add, add_mul, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hij.symm, single_add, add_assoc]

@[simp]
lemma elementary_inv (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    (elementary i j hij a)⁻¹ = elementary i j hij (-a) := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

section Map

variable {S : Type*} [Ring S]

@[simp]
theorem mapRingHom_elementary (f : R →+* S) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    mapRingHom (n := n) f (elementary i j hij a) = elementary i j hij (f a) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom, coe_elementary]
  calc (1 + Matrix.single i j a).map f
      = f.mapMatrix (1 + Matrix.single i j a) := rfl
    _ = f.mapMatrix 1 + f.mapMatrix (Matrix.single i j a) := by rw [RingHom.map_add]
    _ = 1 + f.mapMatrix (Matrix.single i j a) := by rw [RingHom.map_one]
    _ = 1 + (Matrix.single i j a).map f := rfl
    _ = 1 + Matrix.single i j (f a) := by rw [map_single]

end Map

section Reindex

variable {m : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m]

@[simp]
theorem reindexMulEquiv_elementary (e : n ≃ m) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary (e i) (e j) (fun h => hij (e.injective h)) a := by
  apply Units.ext
  rw [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_elementary, coe_elementary]
  have h_add := (reindexRingEquiv R e).map_add (1 : Matrix n n R) (Matrix.single i j a)
  have h_one := (reindexRingEquiv R e).map_one
  rw [coe_reindexRingEquiv] at h_add h_one
  calc reindex e e (1 + Matrix.single i j a)
      = reindex e e (1 : Matrix n n R) + reindex e e (Matrix.single i j a) := h_add
    _ = 1 + reindex e e (Matrix.single i j a) := by rw [h_one]
    _ = 1 + Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a := by
        simp [reindex_apply, submatrix_single_equiv]

end Reindex

section Block

variable {m : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m]

omit [Fintype n] [Fintype m] in
private lemma fromBlocks_single_inl (i j : n) (a : R) :
    fromBlocks (Matrix.single i j a) (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R)
        (0 : Matrix m m R) =
      Matrix.single (Sum.inl (α := n) (β := m) i) (Sum.inl j) a := by
  ext x y
  rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y <;> simp [fromBlocks, Matrix.single]

@[simp]
theorem blockDiagonalOne_elementary (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    blockDiagonalOne (n := n) (m := m) (R := R) (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary (Sum.inl (α := n) (β := m) i) (Sum.inl (α := n) (β := m) j)
        (by intro h; apply hij; cases h; rfl) a := by
  apply Units.ext
  rw [coe_blockDiagonalOne, coe_elementary, coe_elementary]
  have h_eq :
      fromBlocks (1 + Matrix.single i j a) (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R)
          (1 : Matrix m m R) =
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) 0 0 1 +
          fromBlocks (Matrix.single i j a) 0 0 (0 : Matrix m m R) := by
    ext x y
    rcases x with x | x <;> rcases y with y | y <;>
      simp [fromBlocks, Matrix.add_apply]
  calc fromBlocks (1 + Matrix.single i j a) (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R)
          (1 : Matrix m m R)
      = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) 0 0 1 +
          fromBlocks (Matrix.single i j a) 0 0 (0 : Matrix m m R) := h_eq
    _ = (1 : Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) +
          Matrix.single (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) a := by
        rw [fromBlocks_one, fromBlocks_single_inl]

end Block

section Stabilization

@[simp]
theorem stabilization_elementary {k : ℕ} (i j : Fin k) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    stabilization R (n := k) (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1) (Sum.inl i))
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1) (Sum.inl j))
        (by
          intro h
          apply hij
          have h' : Sum.inl (α := Fin k) (β := Fin 1) i =
              Sum.inl (α := Fin k) (β := Fin 1) j :=
            (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1)).injective h
          cases h'
          rfl) a := by
  calc stabilization R (n := k) (elementary i j hij a)
      = reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1))
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin k) (Fin 1) R (elementary i j hij a)) := rfl
    _ = reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1))
          (elementary (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) _ a) := by rw [blockDiagonalOne_elementary]
    _ = elementary (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl j)) _ a := by
        rw [reindexMulEquiv_elementary]

end Stabilization

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Elementary

/-!
# Finite elementary subgroups of `GL n R`

The subgroup `E n R ≤ GL n R` generated by the elementary matrices
`E_{ij}(a)` for an arbitrary (possibly noncommutative) ring `R`.  Provides
coefficient maps, reindexing, and successor stabilization, all preserving the
generating set.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Set of elementary matrices in `GL n R`. -/
def elementarySet (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [Ring R] :
    Set (GL n R) :=
  { g | ∃ (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R), g = elementary i j hij a }

/-- Finite elementary subgroup `Eₙ(R)` as the closure of `elementarySet`. -/
def elementarySubgroup (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [Ring R] :
    Subgroup (GL n R) :=
  Subgroup.closure (elementarySet n R)

/-- Every elementary transvection lies in `Eₙ(R)`. -/
theorem elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    elementary i j hij a ∈ elementarySubgroup n R := by
  apply Subgroup.subset_closure
  exact ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩

namespace ElementarySubgroup

variable {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Bundled elementary generator in `E n R`. -/
def elementary (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) : elementarySubgroup n R :=
  ⟨Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup i j hij a⟩

@[simp]
theorem coe_elementary (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    (↑(elementary i j hij a) : GL n R) = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a :=
  rfl

section Map

variable {S : Type*} [Ring S] {T : Type*} [Ring T]

theorem mapRingHom_mem
    (f : R →+* S) {g : GL n R} (hg : g ∈ elementarySubgroup n R) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := n) f g ∈ elementarySubgroup n S := by
  have hle :
      Subgroup.closure (elementarySet n R) ≤
        (elementarySubgroup n S).comap (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := n) f) := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
    change Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := n) f
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a) ∈ elementarySubgroup n S
    rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_elementary]
    exact Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup _ _ _ _
  exact (Subgroup.mem_comap).mp (hle hg)

/-- Coefficient map `Eₙ(R) →* Eₙ(S)` induced by `f : R →+* S`. -/
def mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) : elementarySubgroup n R →* elementarySubgroup n S :=
  (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := n) f).restrict
    (fun _g hg => mapRingHom_mem (n := n) (R := R) (S := S) f hg)

@[simp]
theorem coe_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) (g : elementarySubgroup n R) :
    (↑(mapRingHom (n := n) (R := R) (S := S) f g) : GL n S) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := n) f (↑g) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem mapRingHom_elementary (f : R →+* S) (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    mapRingHom (n := n) (R := R) (S := S) f (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary i j hij (f a) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_elementary]

@[simp]
theorem mapRingHom_id : mapRingHom (n := n) (R := R) (RingHom.id R) = MonoidHom.id _ := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp

theorem mapRingHom_comp (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    mapRingHom (n := n) (g.comp f) =
      (mapRingHom (n := n) (R := S) (S := T) g).comp
        (mapRingHom (n := n) (R := R) (S := S) f) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp

end Map

end ElementarySubgroup

section Reindex

variable {m : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m]

/-- Reindexing along `e : n ≃ m` preserves `Eₙ(R)`. -/
theorem reindexMulEquiv_mem_elementarySubgroup (e : n ≃ m) {g : GL n R}
    (hg : g ∈ elementarySubgroup n R) :
    reindexMulEquiv e g ∈ elementarySubgroup m R := by
  have hle :
      Subgroup.closure (elementarySet n R) ≤
        (elementarySubgroup m R).comap (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e) := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
    change reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a) ∈
        elementarySubgroup m R
    rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_elementary]
    exact Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup _ _ _ _
  exact (Subgroup.mem_comap).mp (hle hg)

end Reindex

namespace ElementarySubgroup

variable {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] {R : Type*} [Ring R]

section Stabilization

theorem stabilization_mem {k : ℕ} (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    {g : GL (Fin k) R} (hg : g ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin k) R) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R g ∈
      elementarySubgroup (Fin (k + 1)) R := by
  have hle :
      Subgroup.closure (elementarySet (Fin k) R) ≤
        (elementarySubgroup (Fin (k + 1)) R).comap
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R (n := k)) := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
    change Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a) ∈
        elementarySubgroup (Fin (k + 1)) R
    rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization_elementary]
    exact Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup _ _ _ _
  exact (Subgroup.mem_comap).mp (hle hg)

/-- Successor stabilization `Eₙ(R) →* Eₙ₊₁(R)` induced by `GL` stabilization. -/
def stabilization (R : Type*) [Ring R] (k : ℕ) :
    elementarySubgroup (Fin k) R →* elementarySubgroup (Fin (k + 1)) R :=
  (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R (n := k)).restrict
    (fun _g hg => stabilization_mem R (k := k) hg)

@[simp]
theorem coe_stabilization (R : Type*) [Ring R] {k : ℕ}
    (g : elementarySubgroup (Fin k) R) :
    (↑(stabilization R k g) : GL (Fin (k + 1)) R) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R (↑g) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem stabilization_elementary (R : Type*) [Ring R] {k : ℕ}
    (i j : Fin k) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    stabilization R k (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1) (Sum.inl i))
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1) (Sum.inl j))
        (by
          intro h
          apply hij
          have h' : Sum.inl (α := Fin k) (β := Fin 1) i =
              Sum.inl (α := Fin k) (β := Fin 1) j :=
            (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1)).injective h
          cases h'
          rfl) a := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization_elementary]

/-- Naturality of stabilization with respect to coefficient maps. -/
theorem stabilization_mapRingHom {R : Type*} [Ring R] {S : Type*} [Ring S]
    (f : R →+* S) (k : ℕ) :
    (stabilization S k).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin k) f) =
      (mapRingHom (n := Fin (k + 1)) f).comp (stabilization R k) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [coe_mapRingHom, coe_stabilization,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization_mapRingHom_apply]

end Stabilization

end ElementarySubgroup

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

-/
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Defs
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Reindex

/-!
# Coefficient and reindex maps for `GL`

This module provides the arbitrary-semiring, fully cross-universe
`Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom` and the cross-index-universe
`Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv`.

The API is intentionally minimal: one canonical underlying-matrix `simp`
lemma, `id` and `comp` for the coefficient map, a non-`simp` equality to
the existing commutative `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map`, one canonical
underlying-matrix `simp` lemma for reindexing, and coefficient-map
naturality as an equality of bundled `MonoidHom` values with an
element-level `simp` lemma derived from it. No commutativity or
determinant API is assumed. Proofs use bundled extensionality and
definitional reduction for robustness.

## Main definitions

* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom` – arbitrary-semiring, fully
  cross-universe coefficient map via `Units.map` and `RingHom.mapMatrix`.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv` – cross-index-universe
  reindexing equivalence via `Units.mapEquiv` of `Matrix.reindexRingEquiv`.

## Main results

* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom` – underlying-matrix `simp` lemma.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_id` – `id` law.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_comp` – `comp` law.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_eq_map` – non-`simp` equality to the
  existing commutative map.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_reindexMulEquiv` – underlying-matrix `simp`
  lemma for reindexing.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom` – coefficient-map
  naturality as bundled `MonoidHom` equality.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom_apply` – element-level
  `simp` lemma derived from the bundled equality.

-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix
namespace GeneralLinearGroup

universe u v w uR vI wI

variable {n : Type u} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
variable {R : Type v} {S : Type w} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]

/-- Arbitrary-semiring, fully cross-universe coefficient map for `GL`.

Implemented as `Units.map` of `RingHom.mapMatrix`. -/
def mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) : GL n R →* GL n S :=
  Units.map f.mapMatrix.toMonoidHom

@[simp]
lemma coe_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) (g : GL n R) :
    (↑(mapRingHom f g) : Matrix n n S) = (↑g : Matrix n n R).map f :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem mapRingHom_id :
    mapRingHom (R := R) (n := n) (RingHom.id R) = MonoidHom.id (GL n R) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem mapRingHom_comp {T : Type uR} [Semiring T] (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    mapRingHom (g.comp f) = (mapRingHom g).comp (mapRingHom (n := n) f) :=
  rfl

/-- Non-`simp` equality to the existing commutative `GeneralLinearGroup.map`.

Both are definitionally `Units.map` of `RingHom.mapMatrix`; this lemma makes the
connection explicit without entering the `simp` set. -/
theorem mapRingHom_eq_map {R' : Type v} {S' : Type w} [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    {n' : Type u} [DecidableEq n'] [Fintype n'] (f : R' →+* S') :
    (mapRingHom (n := n') f) = (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (n := n') f) :=
  rfl

variable {m : Type vI} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m]
variable {A : Type wI} [Semiring A]

/-- Cross-index-universe reindexing equivalence for `GL` via
`Units.mapEquiv` of `Matrix.reindexRingEquiv`. -/
def reindexMulEquiv (e : n ≃ m) : GL n A ≃* GL m A :=
  Units.mapEquiv (reindexRingEquiv A e).toMulEquiv

@[simp]
lemma coe_reindexMulEquiv (e : n ≃ m) (g : GL n A) :
    (↑(reindexMulEquiv e g) : Matrix m m A) = reindex e e (↑g : Matrix n n A) :=
  rfl

/-- Coefficient-map naturality for reindexing as an equality of bundled
`MonoidHom` values: reindexing after a coefficient map equals the coefficient
map after reindexing, with source `GL n R` and target `GL m S`. -/
theorem reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom {R' : Type v} {S' : Type w}
    [Semiring R'] [Semiring S'] {n' : Type u} {m' : Type vI}
    [DecidableEq n'] [DecidableEq m'] [Fintype n'] [Fintype m']
    (e : n' ≃ m') (f : R' →+* S') :
    (reindexMulEquiv (A := S') e).toMonoidHom.comp (mapRingHom (n := n') f) =
      (mapRingHom (n := m') f).comp (reindexMulEquiv (A := R') e).toMonoidHom := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

/-- Element-level naturality derived from the bundled `MonoidHom` equality. -/
@[simp]
theorem reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom_apply {R' : Type v} {S' : Type w}
    [Semiring R'] [Semiring S'] {n' : Type u} {m' : Type vI}
    [DecidableEq n'] [DecidableEq m'] [Fintype n'] [Fintype m']
    (e : n' ≃ m') (f : R' →+* S') (g : GL n' R') :
    reindexMulEquiv (A := S') e (mapRingHom f g) =
      mapRingHom f (reindexMulEquiv (A := R') e g) :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom e f) g

end GeneralLinearGroup
end Matrix

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Map
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Prod
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Ring.Prod

/-!
# General linear groups over product semirings

This file gives the entrywise ring equivalence
`Matrix n n (R × S) ≃+* Matrix n n R × Matrix n n S` and its induced
multiplicative equivalence
`GL n (R × S) ≃* GL n R × GL n S`.

The coefficient rings and finite matrix index may live in independent
universes.  No topology, commutativity, determinant, or K-theory API is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v

namespace Matrix

variable {R R' : Type u} {S S' : Type v}
variable [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [Semiring R'] [Semiring S']

/-- Entrywise equivalence between matrices over a product ring and pairs of
matrices. -/
def prodRingEquiv (n : Type*) [Fintype n] :
    Matrix n n (R × S) ≃+* Matrix n n R × Matrix n n S where
  toFun A := (A.map (RingHom.fst R S), A.map (RingHom.snd R S))
  invFun A i j := (A.1 i j, A.2 i j)
  left_inv A := by
    ext i j <;> rfl
  right_inv A := by
    rcases A with ⟨A, B⟩
    rfl
  map_add' A B := by
    rfl
  map_mul' A B := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · ext i j
      change (RingHom.fst R S) (∑ k, A i k * B k j) =
        ∑ k, (RingHom.fst R S) (A i k) * (RingHom.fst R S) (B k j)
      simp
    · ext i j
      change (RingHom.snd R S) (∑ k, A i k * B k j) =
        ∑ k, (RingHom.snd R S) (A i k) * (RingHom.snd R S) (B k j)
      simp

@[simp]
theorem prodRingEquiv_apply_fst (n : Type*) [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix n n (R × S)) :
    (prodRingEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n A).1 =
      A.map (RingHom.fst R S) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem prodRingEquiv_apply_snd (n : Type*) [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix n n (R × S)) :
    (prodRingEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n A).2 =
      A.map (RingHom.snd R S) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem prodRingEquiv_symm_apply (n : Type*) [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix n n R × Matrix n n S) (i j : n) :
    (prodRingEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n).symm A i j =
      (A.1 i j, A.2 i j) :=
  rfl

end Matrix

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {R R' : Type u} {S S' : Type v}
variable [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [Semiring R'] [Semiring S']

/-- Finite general linear groups commute with binary products of rings. -/
def prodEquiv (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] :
    GL n (R × S) ≃* GL n R × GL n S :=
  (Units.mapEquiv (Matrix.prodRingEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n).toMulEquiv).trans
    MulEquiv.prodUnits

@[simp]
theorem prodEquiv_apply_fst (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : GL n (R × S)) :
    (prodEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n A).1 =
      mapRingHom (RingHom.fst R S) A := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem prodEquiv_apply_snd (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : GL n (R × S)) :
    (prodEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n A).2 =
      mapRingHom (RingHom.snd R S) A := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_prodEquiv_symm_apply (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : GL n R × GL n S) (i j : n) :
    ((↑((prodEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n).symm A) : Matrix n n (R × S)) i j) =
      ((A.1 : Matrix n n R) i j, (A.2 : Matrix n n S) i j) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem prodEquiv_mapRingHom (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (f : R →+* R') (g : S →+* S') (A : GL n (R × S)) :
    prodEquiv (R := R') (S := S') n (mapRingHom (f.prodMap g) A) =
      (mapRingHom f (prodEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n A).1,
        mapRingHom g (prodEquiv (R := R) (S := S) n A).2) := by
  apply Prod.ext <;> apply Units.ext <;> rfl

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Map
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fin.Basic
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.NoncommCoprod

/-!
# GL stabilization via `diag(A,1)`

The block embedding `A ↦ fromBlocks A 0 0 1` as a `MonoidHom` and the
successor stabilization `GL (Fin n) → GL (Fin (n+1))` via the `Fin 1` block
and reindexing along `finSumFinEquiv`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix

universe u v w

/-- Matrix `MonoidHom` `A ↦ fromBlocks A 0 0 1`. -/
def fromBlocksOneMonoidHom (R : Type w) [Semiring R] (n : Type u) (m : Type v)
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] :
    Matrix n n R →* Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R where
  toFun A := fromBlocks A 0 0 1
  map_one' := fromBlocks_one
  map_mul' A B := by
    calc
      fromBlocks (A * B) (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R) (1 : Matrix m m R)
          = fromBlocks (A * B + (0 : Matrix n m R) * (0 : Matrix m n R))
              (A * (0 : Matrix n m R) + (0 : Matrix n m R) * (1 : Matrix m m R))
              ((0 : Matrix m n R) * B + (1 : Matrix m m R) * (0 : Matrix m n R))
              ((0 : Matrix m n R) * (0 : Matrix n m R) + (1 : Matrix m m R) * 1) := by
            simp
      _ = fromBlocks A (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R) (1 : Matrix m m R) *
            fromBlocks B (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R) (1 : Matrix m m R) :=
        (fromBlocks_multiply A (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R) (1 : Matrix m m R)
          B (0 : Matrix n m R) (0 : Matrix m n R) (1 : Matrix m m R)).symm

end Matrix

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix

universe u v uR vR

section BlockInclusion

variable {n : Type u} {m : Type v} [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m]
variable {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {S : Type vR} [Semiring S]

/-- `GL` inclusion `A ↦ fromBlocks A 0 0 1` via `Units.map`. -/
def blockDiagonalOne (n : Type u) (m : Type v) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] :
    GL n R →* GL (n ⊕ m) R :=
  Units.map (Matrix.fromBlocksOneMonoidHom R n m)

@[simp]
lemma coe_blockDiagonalOne (g : GL n R) :
    (↑(blockDiagonalOne n m R g) : Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) =
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 0 1 :=
  rfl

/-- The actual right block inclusion, obtained from the existing left
block inclusion by exchanging the two index summands. -/
def blockDiagonalRight (n : Type u) (m : Type v) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] :
    GL m R →* GL (n ⊕ m) R :=
  (reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumComm m n)).toMonoidHom.comp (blockDiagonalOne m n R)

/-- Its original matrix is the identity on the left block and the given
matrix on the right block, with zero cross terms. -/
@[simp]
lemma coe_blockDiagonalRight (g : GL m R) :
    (↑(blockDiagonalRight n m R g) : Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) =
      fromBlocks 1 0 0 (↑g : Matrix m m R) := by
  change reindex (Equiv.sumComm m n) (Equiv.sumComm m n)
    (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix m m R) 0 0 1) = _
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;> rfl

/-- Both whole block groups commute in the original general linear group. -/
theorem commute_blockDiagonalOne_blockDiagonalRight (g : GL n R) (h : GL m R) :
    Commute (blockDiagonalOne n m R g) (blockDiagonalRight n m R h) := by
  change blockDiagonalOne n m R g * blockDiagonalRight n m R h =
    blockDiagonalRight n m R h * blockDiagonalOne n m R g
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [Units.val_mul, coe_blockDiagonalOne, coe_blockDiagonalRight,
    fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul, mul_one]

/-- The actual finite two-block diagonal homomorphism. Its source groups
commute in the target by the proved whole-block calculation. -/
def blockDiagonalHom (n : Type u) (m : Type v) (R : Type uR) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] :
    (GL n R × GL m R) →* GL (n ⊕ m) R :=
  (blockDiagonalOne n m R).noncommCoprod (blockDiagonalRight n m R)
    (fun g h => commute_blockDiagonalOne_blockDiagonalRight g h)

/-- The finite pair homomorphism is the literal diagonal matrix with both
original blocks and zero cross terms. -/
@[simp]
theorem coe_blockDiagonalHom (g : GL n R) (h : GL m R) :
    (↑(blockDiagonalHom n m R (g, h)) : Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) =
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 0 (↑h : Matrix m m R) := by
  change (↑(blockDiagonalOne n m R g * blockDiagonalRight n m R h) :
    Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) = _
  simp only [Units.val_mul, coe_blockDiagonalOne, coe_blockDiagonalRight,
    fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul, mul_one]

/-- Inserting the second identity gives the original first block inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem blockDiagonalHom_one_right (g : GL n R) :
    blockDiagonalHom n m R (g, 1) = blockDiagonalOne n m R g := by
  change blockDiagonalOne n m R g * blockDiagonalRight n m R 1 = _
  rw [map_one, mul_one]

/-- Inserting the first identity gives the original second block inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem blockDiagonalHom_one_left (h : GL m R) :
    blockDiagonalHom n m R (1, h) = blockDiagonalRight n m R h := by
  change blockDiagonalOne n m R 1 * blockDiagonalRight n m R h = _
  rw [map_one, one_mul]

theorem blockDiagonalOne_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) :
    (blockDiagonalOne n m S).comp (mapRingHom (n := n) f) =
      (mapRingHom (n := n ⊕ m) f).comp (blockDiagonalOne n m R) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, coe_blockDiagonalOne, coe_mapRingHom,
    fromBlocks_map]
  have h0_nm : (0 : Matrix n m R).map f = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.map_apply, f.map_zero]
  have h0_mn : (0 : Matrix m n R).map f = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.map_apply, f.map_zero]
  have h1 : (1 : Matrix m m R).map f = 1 := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    split
    · simp
    · simp [f.map_zero]
  rw [h0_nm, h0_mn, h1]

@[simp]
theorem blockDiagonalOne_mapRingHom_apply (f : R →+* S) (g : GL n R) :
    blockDiagonalOne n m S (mapRingHom f g) =
      mapRingHom (n := n ⊕ m) f (blockDiagonalOne n m R g) :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (blockDiagonalOne_mapRingHom (n := n) (m := m) (f := f)) g

end BlockInclusion

section SuccStabilization

variable {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] {S : Type vR} [Semiring S]

/-- Successor stabilization `GL (Fin n) → GL (Fin (n+1))`. -/
def stabilization (R : Type uR) [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} :
    GL (Fin n) R →* GL (Fin (n + 1)) R :=
  (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom.comp
    (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R)

@[simp]
lemma coe_stabilization {n : ℕ} (g : GL (Fin n) R) :
    (↑(stabilization R (n := n) g) : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) =
      reindex (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1)) (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))
        (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1) :=
  rfl

theorem stabilization_mapRingHom {n : ℕ} (f : R →+* S) :
    (stabilization S (n := n)).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f) =
      (mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + 1)) f).comp (stabilization R (n := n)) := by
  calc
    (stabilization S (n := n)).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f)
        = ((reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom.comp
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) S)).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f) := rfl
    _ = (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom.comp
          ((blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) S).comp (mapRingHom (n := Fin n) f)) := by
          rw [MonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom.comp
          ((mapRingHom (n := Fin n ⊕ Fin 1) f).comp (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R)) := by
          rw [blockDiagonalOne_mapRingHom]
    _ = ((reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom.comp
          (mapRingHom (n := Fin n ⊕ Fin 1) f)).comp (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R) := by
          rw [← MonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = ((mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + 1)) f).comp
          (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom).comp
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R) := by
          rw [reindexMulEquiv_mapRingHom]
    _ = (mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + 1)) f).comp
          ((reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1))).toMonoidHom.comp
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R)) := by
          rw [MonoidHom.comp_assoc]
    _ = (mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + 1)) f).comp (stabilization R (n := n)) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem stabilization_mapRingHom_apply {n : ℕ} (f : R →+* S) (g : GL (Fin n) R) :
    stabilization S (mapRingHom f g) =
      mapRingHom (n := Fin (n + 1)) f (stabilization R g) :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (stabilization_mapRingHom (n := n) (f := f)) g

end SuccStabilization

/-- `blockDiagonalOne` is injective: equality on the top-left block determines equality. -/
private theorem blockDiagonalOne_injective {R : Type u} [Semiring R]
    {n : Type*} {m : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] :
    Function.Injective (blockDiagonalOne n m R) := by
  intro g₁ g₂ h
  apply Units.ext
  have h_eq : (↑(blockDiagonalOne n m R g₁) : Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) =
      (↑(blockDiagonalOne n m R g₂) : Matrix (n ⊕ m) (n ⊕ m) R) :=
    congrArg Units.val h
  simp only [coe_blockDiagonalOne] at h_eq
  ext i j
  have h_ij := congrFun (congrFun h_eq (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inl j)
  simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁] at h_ij
  exact h_ij

/-- The successor stabilization `GL (Fin n) → GL (Fin (n+1))` is injective. -/
theorem stabilization_injective {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (stabilization (R := R) (n := n)) := by
  intro g₁ g₂ h
  have h_block : blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R g₁ =
      blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R g₂ := by
    apply (MulEquiv.injective (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := n) (n := 1)))) h
  exact blockDiagonalOne_injective h_block

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

universe uBlock₁ uBlock₂ uBlock₃ uScalar

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {α : Type uBlock₁} {β : Type uBlock₂} {γ : Type uBlock₃}
variable [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
variable [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
variable {R : Type uScalar} [Semiring R]

/-- Exchanging the index summands exchanges both complete diagonal blocks. -/
public theorem blockDiagonalHom_sumComm (g : GL α R) (h : GL β R) :
    reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumComm α β) (blockDiagonalHom α β R (g, h)) =
      blockDiagonalHom β α R (h, g) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_blockDiagonalHom]
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;> rfl

/-- The sum associator compares all three complete diagonal blocks. -/
public theorem blockDiagonalHom_sumAssoc
    (g : GL α R) (h : GL β R) (k : GL γ R) :
    reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ)
      (blockDiagonalHom (α ⊕ β) γ R (blockDiagonalHom α β R (g, h), k)) =
      blockDiagonalHom α (β ⊕ γ) R (g, blockDiagonalHom β γ R (h, k)) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_blockDiagonalHom]
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  rcases i with i | (i | i) <;> rcases j with j | (j | j) <;> rfl

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

universe uActive₁ uActive₂ uInactive₁ uInactive₂ uCoeff

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-- The original block stabilization is natural under both index
equivalences. In particular any enumeration of the inactive identity
coordinates preserves the whole active matrix, over arbitrary semirings. -/
public theorem blockDiagonalOne_reindex
    {Active₁ : Type uActive₁} {Active₂ : Type uActive₂}
    {Inactive₁ : Type uInactive₁} {Inactive₂ : Type uInactive₂}
    [DecidableEq Active₁] [DecidableEq Active₂]
    [DecidableEq Inactive₁] [DecidableEq Inactive₂]
    [Fintype Active₁] [Fintype Active₂] [Fintype Inactive₁] [Fintype Inactive₂]
    (R : Type uCoeff) [Semiring R]
    (eA : Active₁ ≃ Active₂) (eI : Inactive₁ ≃ Inactive₂)
    (g : GL Active₁ R) :
    reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumCongr eA eI) (blockDiagonalOne Active₁ Inactive₁ R g) =
      blockDiagonalOne Active₂ Inactive₂ R (reindexMulEquiv eA g) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_blockDiagonalOne]
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
  · change (g : Matrix Active₁ Active₁ R) (eA.symm i) (eA.symm j) =
      (g : Matrix Active₁ Active₁ R) (eA.symm i) (eA.symm j)
    rfl
  · change (0 : R) = 0
    rfl
  · change (0 : R) = 0
    rfl
  · change (1 : Matrix Inactive₁ Inactive₁ R) (eI.symm i) (eI.symm j) =
      (1 : Matrix Inactive₂ Inactive₂ R) i j
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
    exact if_congr eI.symm.injective.eq_iff rfl rfl

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BlockUnipotent
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fin.Basic

/-!
# Finite Whitehead block factorization

`diag(g,g⁻¹)` is a product of six block unipotents, hence lies in `E_{n⊕n}`;
the same yields `diag(⁅g,h⁆,1)` and the reindexed `Fin (n+n)` form over an
arbitrary (possibly noncommutative) ring.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix
open scoped commutatorElement

variable {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Diagonal unit `diag(g,g⁻¹)` on `n ⊕ n`. -/
def diagUnit (g : GL n R) : GL (n ⊕ n) R where
  val := fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 0 (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)
  inv := fromBlocks (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) 0 0 (↑g : Matrix n n R)
  val_inv := by
    have h1 : (↑g : Matrix n n R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
      have := g.val_inv
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h2 : (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
      have := g.inv_val
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp [h1, h2]
  inv_val := by
    have h1 : (↑g : Matrix n n R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
      have := g.val_inv
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h2 : (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
      have := g.inv_val
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp [h1, h2]

@[simp]
lemma coe_diagUnit (g : GL n R) :
    (↑(diagUnit (n := n) (R := R) g) : Matrix (n ⊕ n) (n ⊕ n) R) =
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 0 (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) := rfl

/-! ### Six-unipotent Whitehead identity -/

private lemma diagUnit_val_mul_inv (g : GL n R) :
    (↑g : Matrix n n R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
  have := g.val_inv
  exact_mod_cast this

private lemma diagUnit_inv_mul_val (g : GL n R) :
    (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
  have := g.inv_val
  exact_mod_cast this

/-- Whitehead identity `U(g) L(-g⁻¹) U(g) U(-1) L(1) U(-1) = diagUnit g`. -/
theorem diagUnit_eq_six_unipotent (g : GL n R) :
    BlockElementary.upperUnit (↑g : Matrix n n R) *
      BlockElementary.lowerUnit (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) *
      BlockElementary.upperUnit (↑g : Matrix n n R) *
      BlockElementary.upperUnit (-1 : Matrix n n R) *
      BlockElementary.lowerUnit (1 : Matrix n n R) *
      BlockElementary.upperUnit (-1 : Matrix n n R) = diagUnit g := by
  apply Units.ext
  have h1 := diagUnit_val_mul_inv g
  have h2 := diagUnit_inv_mul_val g
  simp only [BlockElementary.coe_upperUnit, BlockElementary.coe_lowerUnit, coe_diagUnit,
    Units.val_mul]
  have s1 :
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) 1 *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 1 =
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 1 := by
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp [h1]
  have s2 :
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 1 *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) 1 =
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 0 := by
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp [h2]
  have s3 :
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 0 *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (-1 : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) 1 =
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R))
        (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) := by
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp
  have s4 :
      fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R))
          (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) (1 : Matrix n n R) 1 =
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R)
        (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) := by
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp
  have s5 :
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R)
          (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (-1 : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) 1 =
      fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R) (0 : Matrix n n R)
        (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) := by
    rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp
  calc
    fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
        fromBlocks 1 0 (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 1 *
        fromBlocks 1 (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
        fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
        fromBlocks 1 0 (1 : Matrix n n R) 1 *
        fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1
        = (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 0 (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 0 (1 : Matrix n n R) 1) *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 0 (1 : Matrix n n R) 1) *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 := by
          rw [s1]
    _ = (fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) 0 *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 *
          fromBlocks 1 0 (1 : Matrix n n R) 1) *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 := by
          rw [s2, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (fromBlocks (0 : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R))
            (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) *
          fromBlocks 1 0 (1 : Matrix n n R) 1) *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 := by
          rw [s3, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) *
          fromBlocks 1 (-1 : Matrix n n R) 0 1 := by
          rw [s4]
    _ = fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix n n R) 0 0 (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) := s5

theorem diagUnit_mem (g : GL n R) :
    diagUnit g ∈ elementarySubgroup (n ⊕ n) R := by
  rw [← diagUnit_eq_six_unipotent g]
  have hg : BlockElementary.upperUnit (↑g : Matrix n n R) ∈ elementarySubgroup (n ⊕ n) R :=
    BlockElementary.upperUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup _
  have hg_inv : BlockElementary.lowerUnit (-(↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) ∈
      elementarySubgroup (n ⊕ n) R :=
    BlockElementary.lowerUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup _
  have h_m1 : BlockElementary.upperUnit (-1 : Matrix n n R) ∈ elementarySubgroup (n ⊕ n) R :=
    BlockElementary.upperUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup _
  have h1 : BlockElementary.lowerUnit (1 : Matrix n n R) ∈ elementarySubgroup (n ⊕ n) R :=
    BlockElementary.lowerUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup _
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _
    (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hg hg_inv) hg) h_m1) h1) h_m1

/-! ### Commutator `diag(⁅g,h⁆,1)` -/

/-- `diag(⁅g,h⁆,1)` equals `diagUnit g * diagUnit h * diagUnit (g⁻¹*h⁻¹)`. -/
theorem diagUnit_commutator_eq (g h : GL n R) :
    diagUnit g * diagUnit h * diagUnit (g⁻¹ * h⁻¹) =
      blockDiagonalOne n n R ⁅g, h⁆ := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_diagUnit, coe_blockDiagonalOne, Units.val_mul, fromBlocks_multiply,
    mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
  have h_comm : g * h * (g⁻¹ * h⁻¹) = ⁅g, h⁆ := by
    simp [commutatorElement_def, mul_assoc]
  have hg_top : (↑g : Matrix n n R) * (↑h : Matrix n n R) *
      ((↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)) =
      ↑(⁅g, h⁆ : GL n R) := by
    calc
      (↑g : Matrix n n R) * (↑h : Matrix n n R) *
          ((↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix n n R))
          = ↑(g * h * (g⁻¹ * h⁻¹)) := by
            simp [Units.val_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = ↑(⁅g, h⁆ : GL n R) := by rw [h_comm]
  have h_inv : (g⁻¹ * h⁻¹)⁻¹ = h * g := by
    simp
  have h2_h := diagUnit_inv_mul_val h
  have h2_g := diagUnit_inv_mul_val g
  have hg_bot : (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) *
        (↑((g⁻¹ * h⁻¹)⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
    calc
      (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑((g⁻¹ * h⁻¹)⁻¹) : Matrix n n R)
          = (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑(h * g) : Matrix n n R) := by
            rw [h_inv]
      _ = (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) *
          ((↑(h⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑h : Matrix n n R) *
            (↑g : Matrix n n R)) := by
            simp [Units.val_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) := by
            simp [h2_h]
      _ = 1 := h2_g
  rw [hg_top, hg_bot]

theorem diag_commutator_mem (g h : GL n R) :
    blockDiagonalOne n n R ⁅g, h⁆ ∈ elementarySubgroup (n ⊕ n) R := by
  rw [← diagUnit_commutator_eq g h]
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (diagUnit_mem g) (diagUnit_mem h))
    (diagUnit_mem (g⁻¹ * h⁻¹))

/-! ### `Fin (n+n)` reindexed commutator -/

/-- Reindexed `diag(⁅g,h⁆,1)` in `GL (Fin (k+k))`. -/
def reindexedDiagCommutatorUnit (k : ℕ) (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    (g h : GL (Fin k) R) : GL (Fin (k + k)) R :=
  reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := k))
    (blockDiagonalOne (Fin k) (Fin k) R ⁅g, h⁆)

theorem reindexedDiagCommutatorUnit_mem (k : ℕ) (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    (g h : GL (Fin k) R) :
    reindexedDiagCommutatorUnit k R g h ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin (k + k)) R :=
  reindexMulEquiv_mem_elementarySubgroup _ (diag_commutator_mem g h)

@[simp]
theorem coe_reindexedDiagCommutatorUnit (k : ℕ) (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    (g h : GL (Fin k) R) :
    (↑(reindexedDiagCommutatorUnit k R g h) : Matrix (Fin (k + k)) (Fin (k + k)) R) =
      reindex (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := k)) (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := k))
        (fromBlocks (↑(⁅g, h⁆ : GL (Fin k) R) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) R) 0 0 1) := by
  simp only [reindexedDiagCommutatorUnit, coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_blockDiagonalOne]

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Mul
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Star.Real

/-!
# Literal ground-coordinate restriction and zero insertion

These matrices delete a chosen coordinate and reinsert zero there. Their energy comparison
uses the actual principal submatrix, and the restriction plus the ordinary coordinate sum
determines a vector uniquely. The empty remaining subtype is included.

This is the coordinate reduction in Spielman and Teng, arXiv cs/0607105v5, §3.2.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Finset Matrix
open scoped BigOperators Classical

namespace Matrix

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Delete the chosen root coordinate by the corresponding rows of the identity matrix. -/
def groundRestriction (r : V) : Matrix {v : V // v ≠ r} V ℝ :=
  (1 : Matrix V V ℝ).submatrix Subtype.val id

/-- Reinsert a zero root coordinate; this is the transpose of the actual restriction. -/
def zeroInsertion (r : V) : Matrix V {v : V // v ≠ r} ℝ := (groundRestriction r)ᵀ

theorem groundRestriction_mulVec (r : V) (x : V → ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ x = x ∘ Subtype.val := by
  ext v
  simp [groundRestriction, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.one_apply]

omit [Fintype V] in
theorem zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one (r : V) :
    zeroInsertion r = (1 : Matrix V V ℝ).submatrix id Subtype.val := by
  rw [zeroInsertion, groundRestriction, transpose_submatrix, transpose_one]

theorem zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply (r : V) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) (v : V) :
    (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) v = if hv : v = r then 0 else z ⟨v, hv⟩ := by
  rw [zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one]
  by_cases hv : v = r
  · subst v
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, submatrix_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    simp [Ne.symm i.property]
  · rw [dite_eq_right hv]
    have hi (i : {v : V // v ≠ r}) : (v = i.val) ↔ i = ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
      ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h.symm, fun h => (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm⟩
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, submatrix_apply, id_eq, Matrix.one_apply]
    simp_rw [hi]
    simp

@[simp]
theorem zeroInsertion_mulVec_root (r : V) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) r = 0 := by
  simp [zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply]

@[simp]
theorem groundRestriction_mul_zeroInsertion (r : V) :
    groundRestriction r * zeroInsertion r = 1 := by
  have h := one_submatrix_mul (Subtype.val : {v : V // v ≠ r} → V)
    (Equiv.refl V) (zeroInsertion r)
  simp only [Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, Function.id_comp] at h
  rw [groundRestriction, h]
  ext i j
  simp [zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one, Matrix.one_apply, Subtype.val_injective.eq_iff]

theorem groundRestriction_zeroInsertion_mulVec (r : V) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) = z := by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, groundRestriction_mul_zeroInsertion, one_mulVec]

theorem groundRestriction_mul_mul_zeroInsertion (r : V) (A : Matrix V V ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r * A * zeroInsertion r = A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val := by
  have h := one_submatrix_mul (Subtype.val : {v : V // v ≠ r} → V) (Equiv.refl V) A
  simp only [Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, Function.id_comp] at h
  rw [groundRestriction, h, zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one]
  simpa only [Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, Function.id_comp,
    submatrix_submatrix, Function.comp_id] using
      mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl V) (Subtype.val : {v : V // v ≠ r} → V)
        (A.submatrix Subtype.val id)

/-- Grounding identifies the quadratic form of the actual principal submatrix exactly. -/
theorem zeroInsertion_energy (r : V) (A : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) =
      z ⬝ᵥ (A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z) := by
  calc
    (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) =
        z ⬝ᵥ (groundRestriction r *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z))) :=
      (dotProduct_comm _ _).trans
        (dotProduct_transpose_mulVec (groundRestriction r) (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) z)
    _ = z ⬝ᵥ (A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z) := by
      rw [mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, groundRestriction_mul_mul_zeroInsertion]

theorem eq_of_groundRestriction_eq_sum_eq (r : V) {x y : V → ℝ}
    (hxy : groundRestriction r *ᵥ x = groundRestriction r *ᵥ y)
    (hs : ∑ v, x v = ∑ v, y v) : x = y := by
  have hrest (v : V) (hv : v ≠ r) : x v = y v := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ => z ⟨v, hv⟩) hxy
    simpa only [groundRestriction_mulVec, Function.comp_apply] using h
  have hz : ∑ v, (x v - y v) = 0 := by rw [sum_sub_distrib, hs, sub_self]
  have hsingle : ∑ v, (x v - y v) = x r - y r := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single r
    · intro v _ hv
      rw [hrest v hv, sub_self]
    · simp
  have hr : x r = y r := sub_eq_zero.mp (hsingle.symm.trans hz)
  ext v
  by_cases hv : v = r
  · simpa only [hv] using hr
  · exact hrest v hv

end Matrix

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.MatrixSpace.Blowup
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
# Range and rank of a matrix tensored with the identity

The actual map `A ⊗ I` applies `A` independently to each block column. Its range
is the column amplification of the range of `A`, and its rank is the rank of `A`
times the number of block columns. The matrix may be rectangular, with an arbitrary
row type and a finite column type. Empty identity indices are included.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe u v w z

namespace Matrix

open scoped Kronecker

variable {i : Type v} {j : Type w} {d : Type z}
variable [Fintype j] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]

section CommSemiring

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R]

private theorem kronecker_one_project (A : Matrix i j R) (x : j × d → R) (a : d) :
    (fun k : i => ((A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d R)) *ᵥ x) (k, a)) =
      A *ᵥ (fun k : j => x (k, a)) := by
  ext k
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.one_apply]

private theorem kronecker_one_insert (A : Matrix i j R) (a : d) (x : j → R) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d R)) *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert a x =
      LinearMap.columnInsert a (A *ᵥ x) := by
  ext ⟨k, b⟩
  have hc := congrFun (kronecker_one_project A (LinearMap.columnInsert a x) b) k
  by_cases h : b = a
  · subst b
    simpa [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply] using hc
  · have hp : (fun l : j => LinearMap.columnInsert a x (l, b)) = 0 := by
      ext l
      simp [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply, h]
    rw [hp, Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hc
    simpa [LinearMap.columnInsert_apply, h] using hc

/-- Tensoring a matrix with the identity amplifies its actual range column by column. -/
theorem range_kronecker_one (A : Matrix i j R) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d R)).mulVecLin.range = A.mulVecLin.range.columnAmplification d := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.mem_columnAmplification.mpr
    intro a
    exact ⟨fun k : j => x (k, a), (kronecker_one_project A x a).symm⟩
  · rw [Submodule.columnAmplification_eq_iSup]
    refine iSup_le fun a => ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨LinearMap.columnInsert a x, ?_⟩
    change (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d R)) *ᵥ LinearMap.columnInsert a x = LinearMap.columnInsert a y
    rw [kronecker_one_insert]
    exact congrArg (LinearMap.columnInsert a) hx

end CommSemiring

section Field

variable {K : Type u} [Field K]

/-- Tensoring with a finite identity matrix multiplies rank by its size, including size zero. -/
theorem rank_kronecker_one (A : Matrix i j K) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d K)).rank = A.rank * Fintype.card d := by
  change Module.finrank K (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix d d K)).mulVecLin.range =
    Module.finrank K A.mulVecLin.range * Fintype.card d
  rw [range_kronecker_one, Submodule.finrank_columnAmplification]

end Field

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Kronecker
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators

/-!
# Kronecker product distributes over sums

This module provides minimal generic lemmas for distributing the Kronecker
product over `Finset` and `Fintype` sums, abstracting the private copies that
appear in QIT consumers.

Kronecker multiplication is pointwise multiplication of entries, so
`(∑ᵢ Aᵢ) ⊗ₖ B = ∑ᵢ (Aᵢ ⊗ₖ B)` uses right-distributivity `add_mul` and
`zero_mul`, while `A ⊗ₖ (∑ᵢ Bᵢ) = ∑ᵢ (A ⊗ₖ Bᵢ)` uses `mul_add` and `mul_zero`.
Hence `NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring` on the coefficient type suffices; we do not
assume commutativity, associativity of `*`, or a one.

The proofs use the existing `Matrix.add_kronecker`, `Matrix.kronecker_add`,
`Matrix.zero_kronecker`, and `Matrix.kronecker_zero` lemmas and plain
`Finset.induction`.  The `Fintype` corollaries follow from `Finset.univ`;
equivalently they can be obtained from `Matrix.kroneckerBilinear` and
`LinearMap.map_sum` when a `Semiring` instance is available, which yields the
same equalities in one line.

## Main results

* `Matrix.sum_kronecker` – `∑ i ∈ s, f i ⊗ₖ N = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊗ₖ N`
* `Matrix.kronecker_sum` – `∑ i ∈ s, M ⊗ₖ f i = M ⊗ₖ (∑ i ∈ s, f i)`
* `Matrix.sum_kronecker_fintype` – Fintype version of `sum_kronecker`
* `Matrix.kronecker_sum_fintype` – Fintype version of `kronecker_sum`

## Tags

matrix, Kronecker product, Finset sum, Fintype sum
-/

@[expose] public section

open Matrix Finset
open scoped Kronecker

namespace Matrix

variable {l m n p : Type*}
variable {α : Type*} {ι : Type*}

-- Finset sum, left argument varies.

/-- Kronecker product distributes over a `Finset` sum on the left:
`∑ i ∈ s, f i ⊗ₖ N = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊗ₖ N`. -/
theorem sum_kronecker {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Matrix l m α} {N : Matrix n p α}
    [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] :
    ∑ i ∈ s, f i ⊗ₖ N = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ⊗ₖ N := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, add_kronecker, ih]

/-- Kronecker product distributes over a `Finset` sum on the right:
`∑ i ∈ s, M ⊗ₖ f i = M ⊗ₖ (∑ i ∈ s, f i)`. -/
theorem kronecker_sum {s : Finset ι} {M : Matrix l m α} {f : ι → Matrix n p α}
    [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] :
    ∑ i ∈ s, M ⊗ₖ f i = M ⊗ₖ ∑ i ∈ s, f i := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, kronecker_add, ih]

-- Fintype corollaries via `Finset.univ`.

/-- Fintype version of `Matrix.sum_kronecker`. -/
theorem sum_kronecker_fintype [Fintype ι] {f : ι → Matrix l m α} {N : Matrix n p α}
    [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] :
    ∑ i : ι, f i ⊗ₖ N = (∑ i : ι, f i) ⊗ₖ N := by
  calc ∑ _ : ι, _ ⊗ₖ N
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, f i ⊗ₖ N := rfl
    _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, f i) ⊗ₖ N := sum_kronecker
    _ = (∑ _ : ι, f _) ⊗ₖ N := rfl

/-- Fintype version of `Matrix.kronecker_sum`. -/
theorem kronecker_sum_fintype [Fintype ι] {M : Matrix l m α} {f : ι → Matrix n p α}
    [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] :
    ∑ i : ι, M ⊗ₖ f i = M ⊗ₖ ∑ i : ι, f i := by
  calc ∑ _ : ι, M ⊗ₖ f _
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, M ⊗ₖ f i := rfl
    _ = M ⊗ₖ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, f i := kronecker_sum
    _ = M ⊗ₖ ∑ _ : ι, f _ := rfl

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Hermitian
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Star.Real
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators

/-!
# The ordinary vertex-mean projection

The matrix is I minus the all-ones outer product divided by the finite vertex count.
Its action subtracts the ordinary mean, without degree weights. The empty finite type is
included: its unique matrix and vector are zero.

This is the mean removal in Spielman and Teng, arXiv cs/0607105v5, §3.2.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Finset Matrix
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Matrix

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Orthogonal projection onto the ordinary zero-sum subspace of a finite real vector space. -/
def meanProjection : Matrix V V ℝ :=
  1 - (Fintype.card V : ℝ)⁻¹ • vecMulVec (1 : V → ℝ) 1

theorem meanProjection_mulVec (x : V → ℝ) :
    meanProjection *ᵥ x = fun v => x v - (∑ i, x i) / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by
  rw [meanProjection, sub_mulVec, one_mulVec, smul_mulVec]
  ext v
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mulVec, dotProduct,
    vecMulVec_apply, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

@[simp]
theorem transpose_meanProjection : (meanProjection : Matrix V V ℝ)ᵀ = meanProjection := by
  ext i j
  simp [meanProjection, transpose_apply, one_apply, eq_comm]

theorem isHermitian_meanProjection : (meanProjection : Matrix V V ℝ).IsHermitian := by
  rw [IsHermitian, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, transpose_meanProjection]

@[simp]
theorem meanProjection_mulVec_one : meanProjection *ᵥ (1 : V → ℝ) = 0 := by
  ext v
  have : Nonempty V := ⟨v⟩
  have hn : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp [meanProjection_mulVec, hn]

@[simp]
theorem sum_meanProjection_mulVec (x : V → ℝ) : ∑ v, (meanProjection *ᵥ x) v = 0 := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    simp
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    have hn : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
    simp only [meanProjection_mulVec, sum_sub_distrib, sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring

theorem meanProjection_mulVec_eq_self_iff (x : V → ℝ) :
    meanProjection *ᵥ x = x ↔ ∑ v, x v = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hs := congrArg (fun y : V → ℝ => ∑ v, y v) h
    simpa only [sum_meanProjection_mulVec] using hs.symm
  · intro h
    ext v
    simp [meanProjection_mulVec, h]

@[simp]
theorem meanProjection_mul_self :
    (meanProjection : Matrix V V ℝ) * meanProjection = meanProjection := by
  apply Matrix.ext_of_mulVec_single
  intro v
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec]
  exact (meanProjection_mulVec_eq_self_iff _).mpr (sum_meanProjection_mulVec _)

theorem mul_meanProjection {A : Matrix V V ℝ} (hA : A *ᵥ (1 : V → ℝ) = 0) :
    A * meanProjection = A := by
  rw [meanProjection, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_smul, mul_vecMulVec, hA]
  simp

theorem meanProjection_mul {A : Matrix V V ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hA1 : A *ᵥ (1 : V → ℝ) = 0) : meanProjection * A = A := by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (mul_meanProjection hA1)
  simpa only [conjTranspose_mul, isHermitian_meanProjection.eq, hA.eq] using h

omit [DecidableEq V] in
theorem sum_mulVec_eq_zero {A : Matrix V V ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hA1 : A *ᵥ (1 : V → ℝ) = 0) (x : V → ℝ) : ∑ v, (A *ᵥ x) v = 0 := by
  have ht : Aᵀ = A := (conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A).symm.trans hA.eq
  have hrow : (1 : V → ℝ) ᵥ* A = 0 := by
    rw [← mulVec_transpose, ht, hA1]
  have h : (1 : V → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = 0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_mulVec, hrow, zero_dotProduct]
  simpa only [dotProduct, Pi.one_apply, one_mul] using h

/-- Subtracting the ordinary mean preserves the energy of a Hermitian matrix
that annihilates constants. -/
theorem meanProjection_energy {A : Matrix V V ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hA1 : A *ᵥ (1 : V → ℝ) = 0) (x : V → ℝ) :
    (meanProjection *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (meanProjection *ᵥ x)) = x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, mul_meanProjection hA1]
  calc
    (meanProjection *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) =
        x ⬝ᵥ ((meanProjection : Matrix V V ℝ)ᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :=
      (dotProduct_comm _ _).trans
        (dotProduct_transpose_mulVec meanProjection x (A *ᵥ x)).symm
    _ = x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
      rw [transpose_meanProjection, mulVec_mulVec, meanProjection_mul hA hA1]

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Ideal
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Idempotents
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Operations
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Defs

/-!
# Idempotent matrix lifting across a nilpotent quotient

Ordered coefficient products place each matrix-power entry in the
corresponding ideal power. A nilpotent ideal consequently makes the
actual entrywise quotient matrix kernel elementwise nilpotent. The
existing general-ring idempotent-lifting theorem then supplies an
idempotent matrix with the caller's exact original quotient image.

Source: Weibel, *The K-book*, I.Exercise 2.2, the matrix step of
projective nilpotent reduction.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators

universe u v

namespace Matrix

section Semiring

variable {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {n : Type v} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

/-- The entries of an actual matrix power lie in the same ordered ideal power. -/
theorem pow_apply_mem_ideal_pow (I : Ideal R) (A : Matrix n n R)
    (hA : ∀ i j, A i j ∈ I) (k : ℕ) (i j : n) : (A ^ k) i j ∈ I ^ k := by
  induction k generalizing i j with
  | zero =>
      rw [Submodule.pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply, Submodule.pow_succ]
      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ =>
        Submodule.mul_mem_mul (ih i l) (hA l j)

private theorem isNilpotent_of_entries_mem_ideal (I : Ideal R) (hI : IsNilpotent I)
    (A : Matrix n n R) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j ∈ I) : IsNilpotent A := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨k, Matrix.ext fun i j => ?_⟩
  change (A ^ k) i j = 0
  have h := pow_apply_mem_ideal_pow I A hA k i j
  rw [hk] at h
  simpa only [Ideal.zero_eq_bot, Submodule.mem_bot] using h

end Semiring

section Ring

variable {R : Type u} [Ring R] {n : Type v} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
variable (I : Ideal R) [I.IsTwoSided]

/-- Every actual matrix killed by the nilpotent quotient map is nilpotent. -/
theorem isNilpotent_of_quotient_map_eq_zero (hI : IsNilpotent I) (A : Matrix n n R)
    (hA : (Ideal.Quotient.mk I).mapMatrix A = 0) : IsNilpotent A := by
  apply isNilpotent_of_entries_mem_ideal I hI A
  intro i j
  have h := congrArg (fun B : Matrix n n (R ⧸ I) => B i j) hA
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (A i j) = 0 at h
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h

/-- A target idempotent matrix lifts to an actual idempotent source matrix
whose original entrywise quotient map has precisely the specified value. -/
theorem exists_isIdempotentElem_quotient_lift
    (hI : IsNilpotent I) (B : Matrix n n (R ⧸ I)) (hB : IsIdempotentElem B) :
    ∃ A : Matrix n n R, IsIdempotentElem A ∧ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I).mapMatrix A = B := by
  classical
  let f : Matrix n n R →+* Matrix n n (R ⧸ I) := (Ideal.Quotient.mk I).mapMatrix
  have hker : ∀ A ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent A := by
    intro A hA
    exact isNilpotent_of_quotient_map_eq_zero I hI A (RingHom.mem_ker.mp hA)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    have hq : Function.Surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    intro C
    let A : Matrix n n R := fun i j => Function.surjInv hq (C i j)
    refine ⟨A, Matrix.ext fun i j => ?_⟩
    exact Function.surjInv_eq hq (C i j)
  exact _root_.exists_isIdempotentElem_eq_of_ker_isNilpotent f hker B (hsurj B) hB

end Ring

end Matrix
