Authors: @vonbo, Avocado
-/
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Permutation

@[expose] public section

/-!
# Entry formula for permutation matrices

`Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq` gives the entries of `Equiv.Perm.permMatrix`:
`(σ.permMatrix R) i j = if σ i = j then 1 else 0`, requiring only
`[Zero R] [One R]`.

This lives in its own lightweight module — rather than alongside the
monomial-matrix / general-linear-group theory — so that basic results about
permutation matrices (e.g. the Birkhoff–von Neumann 2×2 classification) do
not pull in the permutation-cocycle, determinant, special-linear-group, and
semidirect-product dependencies. It is stated in the `Matrix` namespace,
matching Mathlib's existing permutation-matrix API (`Matrix.permMatrix_one`,
`Matrix.det_permutation`), not the `GeneralLinearGroup` namespace.
-/

open Matrix

namespace Matrix

universe uR uι

variable {R : Type uR} [Zero R] [One R] {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι]

/-- Entry formula for permutation matrices: `(σ.permMatrix R) i j` is `1` if
`σ i = j` and `0` otherwise. Registered as a `simp` lemma. -/
@[simp]
theorem permMatrix_entry_eq (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι) :
    (σ.permMatrix R : Matrix ι ι R) i j = if σ i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have h1 : (σ.permMatrix R) i j =
      if j ∈ (Equiv.toPEquiv σ) i then (1 : R) else 0 := by
    simp [Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, PEquiv.toMatrix_apply]
  have hmem : (j ∈ (Equiv.toPEquiv σ) i) ↔ σ i = j := by
    rw [Equiv.toPEquiv_apply]
    simp
  calc (σ.permMatrix R) i j
      = if j ∈ (Equiv.toPEquiv σ) i then (1 : R) else 0 := h1
    _ = if σ i = j then 1 else 0 := if_congr hmem rfl rfl

end Matrix

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
public import Mathlib.Data.Fin.SuccPred
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Init
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Defs

/-!
# Integral Pfaffians

The Pfaffian is defined by expansion along the first row, with the empty
Pfaffian equal to one. This is a polynomial with integer coefficients: no
division, characteristic assumption, or choice of a square root is involved.

The definition uses the strictly upper triangular entries of any matrix. On
alternating matrices (skew symmetric with zero diagonal, including in
characteristic two) it is the usual Pfaffian. In odd sizes the recursion gives
zero. Principal submatrices can be passed directly to `Matrix.pfaffian`.

The scalar-map theorem and the formulas in sizes zero, one, two and four are
the initial interface. Determinant identities, changes of basis, deletion
vectors and exterior divided powers are outside this leaf's scope.

Reference: D. A. Buchsbaum and D. Eisenbud, *Algebra Structures for Finite Free
Resolutions, and Some Structure Theorems for Ideals of Codimension 3* (1977),
§2, especially Lemma 2.4 and its Pfaffian expansion illustration.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Matrix

universe u v

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

/-- The integral Pfaffian, recursively expanded along the first row.
In each summand `j` indexes the partner of the first row in the remaining
`n + 1` indices; `j.succAbove` deletes that partner before `Fin.succ` restores
the original indexing. -/
def pfaffian : {n : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R → R
  | 0, _ => 1
  | 1, _ => 0
  | n + 2, A =>
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ) * A 0 j.succ *
        pfaffian (A.submatrix (fun i : Fin n => (j.succAbove i).succ)
          (fun i : Fin n => (j.succAbove i).succ))

@[simp]
theorem pfaffian_fin_zero (A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) R) :
    pfaffian A = 1 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem pfaffian_fin_one (A : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) :
    pfaffian A = 0 := rfl

/-- The first-row expansion, without any division. -/
theorem pfaffian_succ_succ {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 2)) (Fin (n + 2)) R) :
    pfaffian A =
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ) * A 0 j.succ *
        pfaffian (A.submatrix (fun i : Fin n => (j.succAbove i).succ)
          (fun i : Fin n => (j.succAbove i).succ)) := rfl

/-- The integral Pfaffian commutes with every homomorphism of commutative
rings, including reduction to positive characteristic. -/
theorem pfaffian_map {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) :
    pfaffian (A.map f) = f (pfaffian A) := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | more n ih _ =>
      simp only [pfaffian_succ_succ, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [← ih (A.submatrix (fun i : Fin n => (j.succAbove i).succ)
        (fun i : Fin n => (j.succAbove i).succ))]
      rfl

@[simp]
theorem pfaffian_fin_two (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) :
    pfaffian A = A 0 1 := by
  simp [pfaffian]

/-- The three terms of the Pfaffian of a four by four matrix. -/
theorem pfaffian_fin_four (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) R) :
    pfaffian A = A 0 1 * A 2 3 - A 0 2 * A 1 3 + A 0 3 * A 1 2 := by
  simp [pfaffian, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.succAbove, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

end Matrix

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.CokernelSchur
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.ScalarCokernelPi
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PivotElimination
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Nondegenerate

/-!
# Actual matrix coordinates for the full pivot cokernel

The coordinate equivalence is the existing sum decomposition and evaluation
on the singleton block. The original matrix map becomes the literal module
block map, with both off-diagonal maps retained. These comparisons connect
division-free determinant elimination to full singular cokernel lengths.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace Matrix

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]

/-- The actual canonical coordinates for the singleton pivot and remaining
indices, using existing linear equivalences. -/
def pivotCoordinates : ((Unit ⊕ ι) → R) ≃ₗ[R] R × (ι → R) :=
  (LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow Unit ι R R).trans
    ((LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit R R).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl R (ι → R)))

/-- The original row matrix, evaluated in the actual singleton coordinate. -/
def pivotRowLinear (r : Matrix Unit ι R) : (ι → R) →ₗ[R] R :=
  (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit R R).toLinearMap.comp r.mulVecLin

/-- The original column matrix, with the actual singleton inverse coordinate. -/
def pivotColumnLinear (c : Matrix ι Unit R) : R →ₗ[R] (ι → R) :=
  c.mulVecLin.comp (LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit R R).symm.toLinearMap

/-- The actual original matrix map is the original module pivot map in
canonical coordinates, rather than an assumed matrix-map comparison. -/
theorem pivotBlock_coordinate_map (a : R) (r : Matrix Unit ι R)
    (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    (pivotCoordinates (R := R) (ι := ι)).toLinearMap.comp
        ((pivotBlock a r c B).mulVecLin.comp (pivotCoordinates (R := R) (ι := ι)).symm.toLinearMap) =
      LinearMap.pivotBlock a (pivotRowLinear r) (pivotColumnLinear c) B.mulVecLin := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  have hy : (LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow Unit ι R R).symm
      ((AddEquiv.funUnique Unit R).symm x, y) ∘ Sum.inr = y := by
    funext i
    rfl
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [hy, pivotCoordinates, pivotBlock, pivotRowLinear, LinearMap.pivotBlock,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  · funext i
    simp [hy, pivotCoordinates, pivotBlock, pivotColumnLinear, LinearMap.pivotBlock,
      Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

/-- The actual Schur matrix map agrees with the original full module
Schur map, preserving the off-diagonal composition. -/
theorem pivotSchur_linear_map (a : R) (r : Matrix Unit ι R)
    (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    (pivotSchur a r c B).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.pivotSchur a (pivotRowLinear r) (pivotColumnLinear c) B.mulVecLin := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  funext i
  simp [pivotSchur, pivotRowLinear, pivotColumnLinear, LinearMap.pivotSchur,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

/-- For every original full-rank pivot matrix over a domain, its full
cokernel lengths satisfy the exact arbitrary-size elimination relation.
Injectivity and coordinate comparison are earned from the determinant and
canonical maps; no length equality or finite-length premise is assumed. -/
theorem length_coker_pivot_matrix_relation [DecidableEq ι] [IsDomain R]
    (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) (r : Matrix Unit ι R) (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R)
    (hA : (pivotBlock a r c B).det ≠ 0) :
    Module.length R (((Unit ⊕ ι) → R) ⧸ (pivotBlock a r c B).mulVecLin.range) +
        (Fintype.card ι : ℕ∞) * Module.length R (R ⧸ (a • (LinearMap.id : R →ₗ[R] R)).range) =
      Module.length R (R ⧸ (a • (LinearMap.id : R →ₗ[R] R)).range) +
        Module.length R ((ι → R) ⧸ (pivotSchur a r c B).mulVecLin.range) := by
  classical
  let e := pivotCoordinates (R := R) (ι := ι)
  let A := pivotBlock a r c B
  let P := LinearMap.pivotBlock a (pivotRowLinear r) (pivotColumnLinear c) B.mulVecLin
  have hAinj : Function.Injective A.mulVecLin := by
    change Function.Injective A.mulVec
    exact Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_det_ne_zero (M := A) hA
  have hp : Function.Injective P := by
    change Function.Injective (LinearMap.pivotBlock a (pivotRowLinear r) (pivotColumnLinear c) B.mulVecLin)
    rw [← pivotBlock_coordinate_map a r c B]
    exact e.injective.comp (hAinj.comp e.symm.injective)
  have hpost := LinearMap.length_coker_postcompose_equiv A.mulVecLin e
  have hpre := LinearMap.length_coker_precompose_equiv (e.toLinearMap.comp A.mulVecLin) e.symm
  have hc : (e.toLinearMap.comp A.mulVecLin).comp e.symm.toLinearMap = P :=
    pivotBlock_coordinate_map a r c B
  rw [hc] at hpre
  have hlength : Module.length R (((Unit ⊕ ι) → R) ⧸ A.mulVecLin.range) =
      Module.length R ((R × (ι → R)) ⧸ P.range) := hpost.symm.trans hpre.symm
  let _ : NoZeroSMulDivisors R (ι → R) := ⟨by
    intro b v h
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · exact Or.inl hb
    · apply Or.inr
      funext i
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (congrFun h i)).resolve_left hb⟩
  have h := LinearMap.length_coker_pivot_relation a ha (pivotRowLinear r) (pivotColumnLinear c)
    B.mulVecLin hp
  rw [← hlength, LinearMap.length_scalar_coker_pi, ← pivotSchur_linear_map] at h
  exact h

end Matrix

-- Author: @toskua
module

public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Determinant.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Adjugate
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin

/-!
# Division-free pivot elimination for arbitrary matrix size

The literal elimination matrix multiplies the original block matrix. Its
determinant relation uses no invertible-pivot or normality premise, and the
empty lower block is included. This is the matrix identity needed by the
singular determinant/cokernel-length induction.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace Matrix

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

/-- The original pivot matrix, including both full off-diagonal blocks. -/
def pivotBlock (a : R) (r : Matrix Unit ι R) (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    Matrix (Unit ⊕ ι) (Unit ⊕ ι) R :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R)) r c B

/-- The actual lower elimination matrix, with no division by its pivot. -/
def pivotElimination (a : R) (c : Matrix ι Unit R) : Matrix (Unit ⊕ ι) (Unit ⊕ ι) R :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R) 0 (-c) (a • (1 : Matrix ι ι R))

/-- The full Schur matrix produced by the literal elimination. -/
def pivotSchur (a : R) (r : Matrix Unit ι R) (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    Matrix ι ι R := a • B - c * r

/-- Multiplication by the actual elimination matrix earns the full upper
block form, without a unit-pivot or nonzero-pivot hypothesis. -/
theorem pivotElimination_mul (a : R) (r : Matrix Unit ι R)
    (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    pivotElimination a c * pivotBlock a r c B =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R)) r 0 (pivotSchur a r c B) := by
  have hc : c * (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R)) = a • c := by
    ext i j
    cases j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, mul_comm]
  unfold pivotElimination pivotBlock pivotSchur
  rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, Matrix.neg_mul,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hc, neg_add_cancel]
  have hd : -(c * r) + a • B = a • B - c * r := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using (add_comm (-(c * r)) (a • B))
  exact congrArg (fun D : Matrix ι ι R =>
    Matrix.fromBlocks (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R)) r (0 : Matrix ι Unit R) D) hd

/-- The original elimination determinant is the exact pivot power for
every lower-block size, including the empty lower block. -/
theorem det_pivotElimination (a : R) (c : Matrix ι Unit R) :
    (pivotElimination a c).det = a ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  unfold pivotElimination
  rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, Matrix.det_one, one_mul,
    Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]

/-- The division-free determinant identity of the actual full pivot and
Schur matrices, valid over singular rings and for every matrix size. -/
theorem det_pivotSchur_relation (a : R) (r : Matrix Unit ι R)
    (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    a * (pivotSchur a r c B).det =
      a ^ Fintype.card ι * (pivotBlock a r c B).det := by
  have h := Matrix.det_mul (pivotElimination a c) (pivotBlock a r c B)
  rw [pivotElimination_mul, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_one,
    Fintype.card_unit, pow_one, mul_one, det_pivotElimination] at h
  exact h

/-- The actual Schur determinant remains nonzero for a nonzero original
determinant and pivot, through the division-free identity. -/
theorem det_pivotSchur_ne_zero [IsDomain R] (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (r : Matrix Unit ι R) (c : Matrix ι Unit R) (B : Matrix ι ι R)
    (hA : (pivotBlock a r c B).det ≠ 0) : (pivotSchur a r c B).det ≠ 0 := by
  intro hS
  have h := det_pivotSchur_relation a r c B
  rw [hS, mul_zero] at h
  exact (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ha) hA) h.symm

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Hermitian
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Matrix
import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.UnitaryBetween
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Unitary.Span
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.PosDef
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Spectrum
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Algebra.Spectrum
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.HermitianFunctionalCalculus

open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator ComplexStarModule ComplexOrder
open Matrix

/-!
# Contractions as averages of two unitaries

This module proves that every finite contraction `‖X‖ ≤ 1` is the average
of two unitaries. The proof obtains a unitary `P` with `P * sqrt(Xᴴ*X) = X`
via `Matrix.exists_unitary_mul_eq_of_isometry`, writes the positive
contraction `sqrt(Xᴴ*X)` as the real part of a unitary using C* functional
calculus and `selfAdjoint.unitarySelfAddISMul`, and then multiplies.

## Main result

* `Matrix.exists_eq_average_two_unitaries_of_norm_le_one` – every
  contraction is the midpoint of two unitaries.
-/

private theorem exists_eq_average_two_unitaries_of_isHermitian
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hPnorm : ‖P‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ W Z : Matrix n n ℂ,
      W ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ∧ Z ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ∧
        P = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (W + Z) := by
  -- Provide the C* order instances for matrices
  let _po : PartialOrder (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (Matrix n n ℂ)
  let _sor : StarOrderedRing (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing (Matrix n n ℂ)
  have hSelf : IsSelfAdjoint P := hP.isSelfAdjoint
  let a : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ) := ⟨P, hSelf⟩
  have ha_norm : ‖a‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have h_eq : ‖a‖ = ‖(a : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := rfl
    calc ‖a‖ = ‖(a : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := h_eq
      _ = ‖P‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ 1 := hPnorm
  let u : unitary (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    selfAdjoint.unitarySelfAddISMul a ha_norm
  let W : Matrix n n ℂ := (u : Matrix n n ℂ)
  let Z : Matrix n n ℂ := star W
  have hW_mem : W ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ := by
    have h : W ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ) := u.prop
    exact h
  have hZ_mem : Z ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ := by
    have hW_unitary : W ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ) := u.prop
    have hStar : star W ∈ unitary (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
      Unitary.star_mem hW_unitary
    exact hStar
  have hReal : (ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) = a :=
    selfAdjoint.realPart_unitarySelfAddISMul a ha_norm
  have hReal_coe : (ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ) = P := by
    have h1 : ((ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) : Matrix n n ℂ)
        = (a : Matrix n n ℂ) := congrArg Subtype.val hReal
    have h2 : (a : Matrix n n ℂ) = P := rfl
    calc (ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ)
        = ((ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : selfAdjoint (Matrix n n ℂ)) : Matrix n n ℂ) := rfl
      _ = (a : Matrix n n ℂ) := h1
      _ = P := h2
  have hReal_apply :
      (ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ) =
        (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((u : Matrix n n ℂ) + star (u : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by
    rw [realPart_apply_coe]
  have hAdd_eq : (u : Matrix n n ℂ) + star (u : Matrix n n ℂ) = W + Z := rfl
  have hP_eq_R : P = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (W + Z) := by
    calc P = (ℜ (u : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ) := hReal_coe.symm
      _ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • ((u : Matrix n n ℂ) + star (u : Matrix n n ℂ)) := hReal_apply
      _ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (W + Z) := by rw [hAdd_eq]
  have hR_to_C_eq :
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (W + Z) = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (W + Z) := by
    have h_scalar : Complex.ofReal ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
      norm_num
    calc (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (W + Z)
        = Complex.ofReal ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) • (W + Z) := by
          rw [← Complex.coe_smul]
      _ = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (W + Z) := by rw [h_scalar]
  have hP_eq_C : P = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (W + Z) := by
    calc P = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (W + Z) := hP_eq_R
      _ = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (W + Z) := hR_to_C_eq
  exact ⟨W, Z, hW_mem, hZ_mem, hP_eq_C⟩

/-- Gram matrix `Xᴴ * X`. -/
private def contractionGram {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  Xᴴ * X

private theorem contractionGram_isHermitian {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : (contractionGram X).IsHermitian :=
  isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self X

private theorem contractionGram_posSemidef {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : (contractionGram X).PosSemidef := by
  classical
  simpa [contractionGram] using posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self X

private theorem contractionGram_norm_le_one {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ 1) : ‖contractionGram X‖ ≤ 1 := by
  unfold contractionGram
  rw [l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  have hNN : 0 ≤ ‖X‖ := norm_nonneg _
  calc ‖X‖ * ‖X‖ ≤ 1 * ‖X‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hNN
    _ = ‖X‖ := one_mul _
    _ ≤ 1 := hX

private theorem contractionGram_eigenvalues_nonneg {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (i : n) :
    0 ≤ (contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i :=
  (contractionGram_posSemidef X).eigenvalues_nonneg i

private theorem contractionGram_eigenvalues_le_one {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ 1) (i : n) :
    (contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i ≤ 1 := by
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ (contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i :=
    contractionGram_eigenvalues_nonneg X i
  have hNorm : ‖contractionGram X‖ ≤ 1 := contractionGram_norm_le_one X hX
  have hMemC : (RCLike.ofReal ((contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i) : ℂ) ∈
      spectrum ℂ (contractionGram X) := by
    rw [(contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.spectrum_eq_image_range]
    exact ⟨(contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hLeMul : ‖(RCLike.ofReal ((contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)‖ ≤
      ‖contractionGram X‖ * ‖(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ :=
    spectrum.norm_le_norm_mul_of_mem hMemC
  have hOne : ‖(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    classical
    have hEq : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = diagonal (fun _ : n => (1 : ℂ)) := by
      ext a b
      simp [diagonal, one_apply]
    rw [hEq, l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    have hPi : ‖(fun _ : n => (1 : ℂ))‖ ≤ 1 := by
      apply pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) |>.mpr
      intro j
      simp
    exact hPi
  have hLe : ‖(RCLike.ofReal ((contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)‖ ≤
      ‖contractionGram X‖ := by
    calc ‖(RCLike.ofReal ((contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)‖
        ≤ ‖contractionGram X‖ * ‖(1 : Matrix n n ℂ)‖ := hLeMul
      _ ≤ ‖contractionGram X‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hOne (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖contractionGram X‖ := mul_one _
  have hEqNorm : ‖(RCLike.ofReal ((contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)‖ =
      (contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg hNonneg]
  calc (contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i
      = ‖(RCLike.ofReal ((contractionGram_posSemidef X).1.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)‖ := hEqNorm.symm
    _ ≤ ‖contractionGram X‖ := hLe
    _ ≤ 1 := hNorm

private noncomputable instance instPartialOrderMatrix {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] :
    PartialOrder (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
  CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (Matrix n n ℂ)

private noncomputable instance instStarOrderedRingMatrix {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] :
    StarOrderedRing (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
  CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing (Matrix n n ℂ)

private theorem contractionGram_nonneg {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : 0 ≤ contractionGram X := by
  unfold contractionGram
  have h : Xᴴ = star X := by rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  rw [h]
  exact star_mul_self_nonneg X

private noncomputable def contractionSqrt {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  CFC.sqrt (contractionGram X)

private theorem contractionSqrt_nonneg {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : 0 ≤ contractionSqrt X :=
  CFC.sqrt_nonneg (contractionGram X)

private theorem contractionSqrt_isHermitian {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : (contractionSqrt X).IsHermitian := by
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ contractionSqrt X := contractionSqrt_nonneg X
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint (contractionSqrt X) := IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg hNonneg
  exact hSA.isHermitian

private theorem contractionSqrt_mul_self {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    contractionSqrt X * contractionSqrt X = contractionGram X :=
  CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self (contractionGram X) (contractionGram_nonneg X)

private theorem contractionSqrt_norm_eq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : ‖contractionSqrt X‖ = ‖X‖ := by
  have hMul : contractionSqrt X * contractionSqrt X = contractionGram X :=
    contractionSqrt_mul_self X
  have hHerm : (contractionSqrt X).IsHermitian := contractionSqrt_isHermitian X
  have hSA : IsSelfAdjoint (contractionSqrt X) := hHerm.isSelfAdjoint
  have hNormSq : ‖contractionSqrt X * contractionSqrt X‖ = ‖contractionSqrt X‖ ^ 2 :=
    hSA.norm_mul_self
  have hGram : ‖contractionGram X‖ = ‖X‖ * ‖X‖ := by
    unfold contractionGram
    rw [l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  have hEqSq : ‖contractionSqrt X‖ ^ 2 = ‖X‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc ‖contractionSqrt X‖ ^ 2
        = ‖contractionSqrt X * contractionSqrt X‖ := hNormSq.symm
      _ = ‖contractionGram X‖ := by rw [hMul]
      _ = ‖X‖ * ‖X‖ := hGram
      _ = ‖X‖ ^ 2 := by ring
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖contractionSqrt X‖ - ‖X‖), norm_nonneg (contractionSqrt X),
    norm_nonneg X]

private theorem contractionSqrt_norm_le_one {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ 1) : ‖contractionSqrt X‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rw [contractionSqrt_norm_eq X]
  exact hX

private theorem contractionSqrt_spectral {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    contractionSqrt X =
      (contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorUnitary.val *
        diagonal (fun i =>
          (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *
        star ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorUnitary.val) := by
  have hA : IsHermitian (contractionGram X) := contractionGram_isHermitian X
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ contractionGram X := contractionGram_nonneg X
  calc contractionSqrt X
      = CFC.sqrt (contractionGram X) := rfl
    _ = cfcₙ Real.sqrt (contractionGram X) := by
        rw [CFC.sqrt_eq_real_sqrt (contractionGram X) hNonneg]
    _ = cfc Real.sqrt (contractionGram X) := by
        rw [cfcₙ_eq_cfc]
    _ = hA.cfc Real.sqrt := by
        rw [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc_eq]
    _ = Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ hA.eigenvectorUnitary
          (diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ Real.sqrt ∘ hA.eigenvalues)) := by
        rw [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc]
    _ = hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *
          diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ Real.sqrt ∘ hA.eigenvalues) *
          star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val) := by
        rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
    _ = (contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorUnitary.val *
          diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *
          star ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorUnitary.val) := by
        rfl

private theorem contractionSqrt_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (j : n) :
    contractionSqrt X *ᵥ
        ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis j) =
      (RCLike.ofReal
          (Real.sqrt ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) •
        ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis j) := by
  let hA := contractionGram_isHermitian X
  have hSpec : contractionSqrt X =
      hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *
        diagonal (fun i =>
          (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *
        star hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val :=
    contractionSqrt_spectral X
  let v : n → ℂ := ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
  have hStar : (star hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val) *ᵥ v = Pi.single j 1 :=
    hA.star_eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec j
  have hU : hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 = v :=
    hA.eigenvectorUnitary_mulVec j
  have hDiag :
      diagonal (fun i =>
          (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *ᵥ
        Pi.single j 1 =
        (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) •
          Pi.single j 1 := by
    have h1 :
        diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *ᵥ
          Pi.single j 1 =
          Pi.single j
            ((RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) * 1) :=
      Matrix.diagonal_mulVec_single _ j 1
    have h2 :
        Pi.single j
            ((RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) * 1) =
          (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) •
            Pi.single j 1 := by
      ext k
      simp [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    calc diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *ᵥ
          Pi.single j 1
        = Pi.single j
            ((RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) * 1) := h1
      _ = (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) •
            Pi.single j 1 := h2
  calc contractionSqrt X *ᵥ v
      = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *
          diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *
          star hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val) *ᵥ v := by
        rw [hSpec]
    _ = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *
          diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ))) *ᵥ
          ((star hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val) *ᵥ v) := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    _ = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *
          diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ))) *ᵥ
          Pi.single j 1 := by
        rw [hStar]
    _ = hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *ᵥ
          (diagonal (fun i =>
            (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues i)) : ℂ)) *ᵥ
            Pi.single j 1) := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    _ = hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *ᵥ
          ((RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) •
            Pi.single j 1) := by
        rw [hDiag]
    _ = (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) •
          (hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val *ᵥ Pi.single j 1) := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    _ = (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) • v := by
        rw [hU]

private noncomputable abbrev contractionSupport {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Type _ :=
  { j : n // 0 < (contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues j }

private noncomputable def contractionSupportBasis {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n (contractionSupport X) ℂ :=
  fun i s => (contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorUnitary.val i s.1

private theorem contractionSupportBasis_isometry {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix.IsIsometry (contractionSupportBasis X) := by
  classical
  let hA := contractionGram_isHermitian X
  let U := hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val
  have hU_mem : U ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary.prop
  have hStar : star U * U = 1 := mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.mp hU_mem
  have hUU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := by
    calc Uᴴ * U = star U * U := by
          rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
      _ = 1 := hStar
  unfold Matrix.IsIsometry
  ext s t
  have hEq : (contractionSupportBasis X)ᴴ * contractionSupportBasis X =
      (contractionSupportBasis X)ᴴ * contractionSupportBasis X := rfl
  have hMul :
      ((contractionSupportBasis X)ᴴ * contractionSupportBasis X) s t =
        (Uᴴ * U) s.1 t.1 := by
    simp only [contractionSupportBasis, conjTranspose_apply, mul_apply,
      RCLike.star_def]
    rfl
  have hUU_entry :
      (Uᴴ * U) s.1 t.1 = (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) s.1 t.1 := by
    rw [hUU]
  have hOne_n : (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) s.1 t.1 =
      if s.1 = t.1 then 1 else 0 := by
    simp [one_apply]
  have hValNe : s ≠ t → s.1 ≠ t.1 := by
    intro hne heq
    have : s = t := Subtype.ext heq
    exact hne this
  have hIfEq :
      (if s.1 = t.1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
        if s = t then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hs : s = t
    · subst hs
      simp
    · have hv : s.1 ≠ t.1 := hValNe hs
      simp [hv, hs]
  calc ((contractionSupportBasis X)ᴴ * contractionSupportBasis X) s t
      = (Uᴴ * U) s.1 t.1 := hMul
    _ = (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) s.1 t.1 := hUU_entry
    _ = if s.1 = t.1 then 1 else 0 := hOne_n
    _ = if s = t then 1 else 0 := hIfEq
    _ = (1 : Matrix (contractionSupport X) (contractionSupport X) ℂ) s t := by
        simp [one_apply]

private theorem contractionGram_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (j : n) :
    contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis j) =
      ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues j) •
        ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis j) :=
  (contractionGram_isHermitian X).mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j

private noncomputable def contractionSupport_sqrt {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : contractionSupport X) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt ((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues s.1)

private theorem contractionSupport_sqrt_pos {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : contractionSupport X) :
    0 < contractionSupport_sqrt X s := by
  unfold contractionSupport_sqrt
  exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr s.2

private theorem contractionSupport_sqrt_sq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (s : contractionSupport X) :
    (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) ^ 2 = (contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvalues s.1 := by
  unfold contractionSupport_sqrt
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt s.2)

private noncomputable def contractionSupport_image {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n (contractionSupport X) ℂ :=
  fun i s =>
    ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
        (X *ᵥ ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis s.1))) i

private theorem contractionSupport_image_isometry {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix.IsIsometry (contractionSupport_image X) := by
  classical
  let hA := contractionGram_isHermitian X
  have hOrtho : Orthonormal ℂ (fun i => hA.eigenvectorBasis i) :=
    hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal
  have hInner : ∀ i j : n,
      inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) (hA.eigenvectorBasis j) =
        if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro i j
    have h := (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hOrtho) i j
    simpa using h
  have hFullDot : ∀ i j : n,
      (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) =
        if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro i j
    have hEq : (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) =
        inner (𝕜 := ℂ) (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) (hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]
    rw [hEq, hInner]
  -- Gram inner product of `X v` via `Xᴴ * X`
  have hStarDot : ∀ a b : n,
      (star (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a)) ⬝ᵥ X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b)) =
        (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a)) ⬝ᵥ
          (contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b))) := by
    intro a b
    calc (star (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a)) ⬝ᵥ X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b))
        = ((star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a))) ᵥ* Xᴴ ⬝ᵥ X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b)) := by
          rw [Matrix.star_mulVec]
      _ = (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a)) ⬝ᵥ Xᴴ *ᵥ X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b)) := by
          rw [← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
      _ = (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a)) ⬝ᵥ (Xᴴ * X) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b)) := by
          rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      _ = (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis a)) ⬝ᵥ
          (contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis b))) := rfl
  have hGramEig : ∀ j : n,
      contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) =
        (hA.eigenvalues j) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) :=
    fun j => contractionGram_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis X j
  -- Eigenvector equation plus real-to-complex scalar
  have hDotEig : ∀ i j : n,
      (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ
        (contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j))) =
        (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) *
          (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) := by
    intro i j
    rw [hGramEig j]
    have hSmul : ∀ k : n,
        ((hA.eigenvalues j) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) : n → ℂ) k =
          (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) * ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) k := by
      intro k
      simp [Pi.smul_apply, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
    calc (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ
            (hA.eigenvalues j) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j))
        = ∑ k : n, star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) k) *
            ((hA.eigenvalues j) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) : n → ℂ) k := rfl
      _ = ∑ k : n, star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) k) *
            ((RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) * ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) k) := by
          simp_rw [hSmul]
      _ = (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) *
          ∑ k : n, star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) k) * ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) k := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          ext k
          ring
      _ = (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) *
          (star (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) := rfl
  have hDot : ∀ i j : n,
      (star (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)) ⬝ᵥ X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) =
        (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues j) : ℂ) *
          if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [hStarDot i j, hDotEig i j, hFullDot i j]
  have hSqrtNe : ∀ s : contractionSupport X,
      (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro s
    exact RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (contractionSupport_sqrt_pos X s))
  -- Real scalar: star fixes `ofReal`
  have hStarReal : ∀ r : ℝ, star (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) = RCLike.ofReal r := by
    intro r
    rw [RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal]
  have hStarInv : ∀ s : contractionSupport X,
      star ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹) =
        (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
    intro s
    rw [star_inv₀, hStarReal]
  -- Factor normalized columns: `c_s⁻¹ c_t⁻¹ * ⟨X v_s, X v_t⟩`
  have hImageEntry : ∀ s t : contractionSupport X,
      ((contractionSupport_image X)ᴴ * contractionSupport_image X) s t =
        (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (star (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) ⬝ᵥ
            X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis t.1)) := by
    intro s t
    simp only [conjTranspose_apply, mul_apply, contractionSupport_image,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct]
    have hStarSmul : ∀ i : n,
        star (((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i)) =
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            star ((X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i) := by
      intro i
      rw [star_mul, hStarInv s, mul_comm]
    calc ∑ i : n, star ((contractionSupport_image X) i s) * (contractionSupport_image X) i t
        = ∑ i : n,
            star (((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i)) *
              ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis t.1)) i) := rfl
      _ = ∑ i : n,
            ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              star ((X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i)) *
              ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis t.1)) i) := by
          simp_rw [hStarSmul]
      _ = (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ i : n, star ((X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i) *
            (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis t.1)) i := by
          have hComm : ∀ i : n,
              (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                star ((X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i) *
                ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                  (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis t.1)) i) =
                (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                  (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                  (star ((X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)) i) *
                    (X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis t.1)) i) := by
            intro i; ring
          simp_rw [hComm, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  unfold Matrix.IsIsometry
  ext s t
  rw [hImageEntry s t, hDot s.1 t.1]
  have hIf : (if s.1 = t.1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
      if s = t then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    by_cases hs : s = t
    · subst hs; simp
    · have hNeVal : s.1 ≠ t.1 := by
        intro hEq
        exact hs (Subtype.ext hEq)
      simp [hNeVal, hs]
  rw [hIf]
  by_cases hs : s = t
  · subst hs
    have hSq : (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) ^ 2 = hA.eigenvalues s.1 :=
      contractionSupport_sqrt_sq X s
    have hOfRealSq : (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) ^ 2 =
        (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues s.1) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, hSq]
    have hNe : (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := hSqrtNe s
    calc (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ((RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues s.1) : ℂ) * if s = s then 1 else 0)
        = (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues s.1) : ℂ) := by simp
      _ = (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) ^ 2 := by rw [hOfRealSq]
      _ = 1 := by
          have hInv : (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) = 1 :=
            inv_mul_cancel₀ hNe
          calc (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) ^ 2
              = (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                ((RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) *
                (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)) := by ring
            _ = (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                (1 * (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)) := by rw [hInv]
            _ = 1 := by rw [one_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNe]
      _ = (1 : Matrix (contractionSupport X) (contractionSupport X) ℂ) s s := by
          simp
  · have hZero : (if s = t then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = 0 := by simp [hs]
    calc (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X t) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ((RCLike.ofReal (hA.eigenvalues t.1) : ℂ) * if s = t then 1 else 0)
        = 0 := by rw [hZero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      _ = (1 : Matrix (contractionSupport X) (contractionSupport X) ℂ) s t := by
          simp [hs]

private theorem exists_contractionPolarUnitary {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ U : Matrix n n ℂ, U ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ∧
      U * contractionSupportBasis X = contractionSupport_image X := by
  classical
  have hB : Matrix.IsIsometry (contractionSupportBasis X) :=
    contractionSupportBasis_isometry X
  have hI : Matrix.IsIsometry (contractionSupport_image X) :=
    contractionSupport_image_isometry X
  exact Matrix.exists_unitary_mul_eq_of_isometry
    (contractionSupportBasis X) (contractionSupport_image X) hB hI

private theorem contractionPolarUnitary_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (_hU : U ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ)
    (hEq : U * contractionSupportBasis X = contractionSupport_image X)
    (s : contractionSupport X) :
    (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ
        ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis s.1) =
      X *ᵥ ⇑((contractionGram_isHermitian X).eigenvectorBasis s.1) := by
  classical
  let hA := contractionGram_isHermitian X
  let v : n → ℂ := ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis s.1)
  let c : ℂ := (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ)
  have hc_pos : 0 < contractionSupport_sqrt X s :=
    contractionSupport_sqrt_pos X s
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := by
    unfold c
    exact RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hc_pos)
  have hSqrt : contractionSqrt X *ᵥ v = c • v := by
    have h0 := contractionSqrt_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis X s.1
    have h1 : contractionSupport_sqrt X s =
        Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues s.1) := rfl
    calc contractionSqrt X *ᵥ v
        = (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues s.1)) : ℂ) • v := h0
      _ = (RCLike.ofReal (contractionSupport_sqrt X s) : ℂ) • v := by
          rw [h1]
      _ = c • v := rfl
  have hBasis_col : (contractionSupportBasis X).col s = v := by
    ext i
    simp only [contractionSupportBasis, Matrix.col_apply,
      hA.eigenvectorUnitary_apply, v]
  have hBasis_mul : contractionSupportBasis X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 = v := by
    calc contractionSupportBasis X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1
        = (contractionSupportBasis X).col s := by
          rw [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
      _ = v := hBasis_col
  have hImage_col : (contractionSupport_image X).col s =
      c⁻¹ • (X *ᵥ v) := by
    ext i
    simp only [contractionSupport_image, Matrix.col_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, v, c]
  have hImage_mul : contractionSupport_image X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 =
      c⁻¹ • (X *ᵥ v) := by
    calc contractionSupport_image X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1
        = (contractionSupport_image X).col s := by
          rw [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
      _ = c⁻¹ • (X *ᵥ v) := hImage_col
  have hU_v : U *ᵥ v = c⁻¹ • (X *ᵥ v) := by
    have hLeft : (U * contractionSupportBasis X) *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 =
        U *ᵥ (contractionSupportBasis X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    have hRight : (U * contractionSupportBasis X) *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 =
        contractionSupport_image X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 := by
      rw [hEq]
    calc U *ᵥ v
        = U *ᵥ (contractionSupportBasis X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1) := by
          rw [hBasis_mul]
      _ = (U * contractionSupportBasis X) *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 := hLeft.symm
      _ = contractionSupport_image X *ᵥ Pi.single s 1 := hRight
      _ = c⁻¹ • (X *ᵥ v) := hImage_mul
  have hMul : (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ v =
      U *ᵥ (contractionSqrt X *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  calc (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ v
      = U *ᵥ (contractionSqrt X *ᵥ v) := hMul
    _ = U *ᵥ (c • v) := by rw [hSqrt]
    _ = c • (U *ᵥ v) := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    _ = c • (c⁻¹ • (X *ᵥ v)) := by rw [hU_v]
    _ = (c * c⁻¹) • (X *ᵥ v) := by rw [smul_smul]
    _ = (1 : ℂ) • (X *ᵥ v) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hc_ne]
    _ = X *ᵥ v := by rw [one_smul]

private theorem exists_contractionPolarUnitary_mul_contractionSqrt_eq
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    ∃ U : Matrix n n ℂ,
      U ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ∧ U * contractionSqrt X = X := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hU_mem, hU_eq⟩ := exists_contractionPolarUnitary X
  refine ⟨U, hU_mem, ?_⟩
  let hA := contractionGram_isHermitian X
  have hBasisEq : ∀ j : n,
      (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) =
        X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hPos : 0 < hA.eigenvalues j
    · exact contractionPolarUnitary_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis X U hU_mem hU_eq ⟨j, hPos⟩
    · have hNonneg : 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues j := contractionGram_eigenvalues_nonneg X j
      have hZero : hA.eigenvalues j = 0 := by
        have hLe : hA.eigenvalues j ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hPos
        linarith
      have hGram : contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) = 0 := by
        calc contractionGram X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
            = (hA.eigenvalues j) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) :=
              contractionGram_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis X j
          _ = (0 : ℝ) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := by rw [hZero]
          _ = 0 := by simp
      have hXZero : X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) = 0 := by
        have hEquiv :=
          Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_mulVec_eq_zero X ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
        have hGramEq : (Xᴴ * X) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) = 0 := by
          simpa [contractionGram] using hGram
        exact hEquiv.mp hGramEq
      have hSqrtZero : contractionSqrt X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) = 0 := by
        calc contractionSqrt X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
            = (RCLike.ofReal
                (Real.sqrt (hA.eigenvalues j)) : ℂ) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) :=
              contractionSqrt_mulVec_eigenvectorBasis X j
          _ = (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt 0) : ℂ) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := by
              rw [hZero]
          _ = 0 := by simp [Real.sqrt_zero]
      have hUSqrtZero :
          (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) = 0 := by
        calc (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
            = U *ᵥ (contractionSqrt X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)) := by
              rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
          _ = U *ᵥ (0 : n → ℂ) := by rw [hSqrtZero]
          _ = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_zero]
      calc (U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
          = 0 := hUSqrtZero
        _ = X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := by rw [hXZero]
        _ = X *ᵥ ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) := rfl
  let V := hA.eigenvectorUnitary.val
  have hV_mem : V ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary.prop
  have hVCol : ∀ j : n, Matrix.col V j = ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j) :=
    fun j => hA.eigenvectorUnitary_col_eq j
  have hMulV : (U * contractionSqrt X) * V = X * V := by
    ext i j
    have h1 : ((U * contractionSqrt X) * V) i j =
        ((U * contractionSqrt X) *ᵥ Matrix.col V j) i := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col_apply]
    have h2 : (X * V) i j = (X *ᵥ Matrix.col V j) i := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col_apply]
    rw [h1, h2, hVCol j, hBasisEq j]
  have hStar : V * star V = 1 := mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp hV_mem
  calc U * contractionSqrt X
      = (U * contractionSqrt X) * 1 := by rw [mul_one]
    _ = (U * contractionSqrt X) * (V * star V) := by rw [← hStar]
    _ = (U * contractionSqrt X * V) * star V := by rw [← mul_assoc]
    _ = (X * V) * star V := by rw [hMulV]
    _ = X * (V * star V) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = X * 1 := by rw [hStar]
    _ = X := by rw [mul_one]

namespace Matrix

public theorem exists_eq_average_two_unitaries_of_norm_le_one
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ U V : Matrix n n ℂ,
      U ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ∧ V ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ∧
        X = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (U + V) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP_mem, hP_eq⟩ :=
    exists_contractionPolarUnitary_mul_contractionSqrt_eq X
  have hSqrt_herm : (contractionSqrt X).IsHermitian :=
    contractionSqrt_isHermitian X
  have hSqrt_norm : ‖contractionSqrt X‖ ≤ 1 :=
    contractionSqrt_norm_le_one X hX
  obtain ⟨W, Z, hW_mem, hZ_mem, hSqrt_avg⟩ :=
    exists_eq_average_two_unitaries_of_isHermitian
      (contractionSqrt X) hSqrt_herm hSqrt_norm
  refine ⟨P * W, P * Z, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (unitaryGroup n ℂ).mul_mem hP_mem hW_mem
  · exact (unitaryGroup n ℂ).mul_mem hP_mem hZ_mem
  · calc X = P * contractionSqrt X := hP_eq.symm
      _ = P * (((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (W + Z)) := by rw [hSqrt_avg]
      _ = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (P * (W + Z)) := by rw [Matrix.mul_smul]
      _ = ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) • (P * W + P * Z) := by rw [Matrix.mul_add]

end Matrix

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GroundCoordinates
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
public import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination

/-!
# Sparse degree-one elimination of an SDDM matrix

The primitive computes one retained diagonal update, one forward right-hand-side update,
and the back-substituted pivot coordinate from the original matrix entries. The full pivot
diagonal is retained in every denominator, including its nonnegative diagonal surplus.

These are the degree-one operations in Spielman and Teng, *Nearly-Linear Time Algorithms for
Preconditioning and Solving Symmetric, Diagonally Dominant Linear Systems*, arXiv cs/0607105v5,
current typesetting 26 November 2024, §§1.1, 3.1, 4.1 and 5. This module supplies one matrix
primitive, not the complete sparse state, pivot queue, factor chain, or operation-count proof.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Finset
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Matrix

variable {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]

/-- Delete the pivot coordinate and update only its retained neighbor's diagonal. -/
def degreeOnePivot (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    Matrix {v : V // v ≠ r} {v : V // v ≠ r} ℝ :=
  fun i j => if i = u ∧ j = u then
    A u.val u.val - (A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r else A i.val j.val

/-- Sparse forward substitution: only the retained neighbor's right-hand side changes. -/
def degreeOneRHS (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    (V → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) where
  toFun b := Function.update (fun v => b v.val) u
    (b u.val - A r u.val * b r / A r r)
  map_add' b c := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = u
    · subst i
      simp only [Function.update_self, Pi.add_apply]
      ring
    · simp [hi]
  map_smul' k b := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = u
    · subst i
      simp only [Function.update_self, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
      ring
    · simp [hi]

/-- Back substitution, linear in the original right-hand side and retained candidate. -/
def degreeOneLift (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    (V → ℝ) × ({v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ) where
  toFun bz i := if hi : i = r then (bz.1 r - A r u.val * bz.2 u) / A r r else bz.2 ⟨i, hi⟩
  map_add' bz cw := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst i
      simp
      ring
    · simp [hi]
  map_smul' k bz := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst i
      simp
      ring
    · simp [hi]

/-- The computed normalized Cholesky column of this pivot, in the original coordinates. -/
def degreeOneColumn (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u : {v : V // v ≠ r}) : V → ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (A r r) • Pi.single r 1 + (A r u.val / Real.sqrt (A r r)) • Pi.single u.val 1

variable (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u : {v : V // v ≠ r})

theorem degreeOnePivot_apply (i j : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    degreeOnePivot A r u i j =
      A i.val j.val - if i = u ∧ j = u then (A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r else 0 := by
  by_cases hi : i = u <;> by_cases hj : j = u <;>
    simp [degreeOnePivot, hi, hj]

@[simp]
theorem degreeOnePivot_apply_of_ne {i j : {v : V // v ≠ r}} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    degreeOnePivot A r u i j = A i.val j.val := by
  rw [degreeOnePivot_apply]
  have h : ¬ (i = u ∧ j = u) := fun h => hij (h.1.trans h.2.symm)
  simp [h]

@[simp]
theorem degreeOneRHS_apply (b : V → ℝ) (i : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    degreeOneRHS A r u b i =
      b i.val - if i = u then A r u.val * b r / A r r else 0 := by
  by_cases hi : i = u <;> simp [degreeOneRHS, hi]

@[simp]
theorem degreeOneLift_root (b : V → ℝ) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) r = (b r - A r u.val * z u) / A r r := by
  simp [degreeOneLift]

@[simp]
theorem degreeOneLift_retained (b : V → ℝ) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ)
    (i : {v : V // v ≠ r}) : degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) i.val = z i := by
  simp [degreeOneLift, i.property]

theorem degreeOneColumn_eq_zero {i : V} (hir : i ≠ r) (hiu : i ≠ u.val) :
    degreeOneColumn A r u i = 0 := by
  simp [degreeOneColumn, hir, hiu]

private theorem pivot_rank : degreeOnePivot A r u =
    A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val -
      ((A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r) • vecMulVec (Pi.single u 1) (Pi.single u 1) := by
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i = u <;> by_cases hj : j = u <;>
    simp [degreeOnePivot_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, vecMulVec_apply, hi, hj]

private theorem rhs_sub (b : V → ℝ) : degreeOneRHS A r u b =
    (fun i => b i.val) - (A r u.val * b r / A r r) • Pi.single u 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = u <;> simp [degreeOneRHS_apply, hi]

private def liftMatrix : Matrix V {v : V // v ≠ r} ℝ :=
  zeroInsertion r - (A r u.val / A r r) • vecMulVec (Pi.single r 1) (Pi.single u 1)

variable [Fintype V]

private theorem lift_add (b : V → ℝ) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) = zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z +
      ((b r - A r u.val * z u) / A r r) • Pi.single r 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    simp
  · simp [degreeOneLift, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, hi]

private theorem zeroInsertion_single :
    zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (Pi.single u 1) = Pi.single u.val 1 := by
  ext i
  simp [zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one, mulVec_single, Matrix.one_apply, Pi.single_apply]

private theorem principal_action (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) =
      A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z := by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, groundRestriction_mul_mul_zeroInsertion]

private theorem pivot_row_action
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0)
    (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) r = A r u.val * z u := by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one]
  have hm := mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl V) (Subtype.val : {v : V // v ≠ r} → V) A
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Equiv.refl_symm, Function.id_comp] at hm
  rw [hm, mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_eq_single u]
  · rfl
  · intro j _ hju
    have hj : j.val ≠ u.val := fun h => hju (Subtype.ext h)
    simp [hs j.val j.property hj]
  · simp

private theorem column_action (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) :
    A *ᵥ Pi.single r 1 = A r r • Pi.single r 1 + A r u.val • Pi.single u.val 1 := by
  rw [mulVec_single_one]
  ext i
  change A i r = A r r * (Pi.single r 1 : V → ℝ) i +
    A r u.val * (Pi.single u.val 1 : V → ℝ) i
  have hsym : A i r = A r i := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.apply r i
  rw [hsym]
  by_cases hir : i = r
  · subst i
    simp [Ne.symm u.property]
  · by_cases hiu : i = u.val
    · subst i
      simp [u.property]
    · simp [hir, hiu, hs i hir hiu]

private theorem action_split
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0)
    (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) =
      zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z) +
        (A r u.val * z u) • Pi.single r 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    rw [pivot_row_action A r u hs z, Pi.add_apply, zeroInsertion_mulVec_root]
    simp
  · have h := congrArg (fun x : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ => x ⟨i, hi⟩)
      (principal_action A r z)
    simpa only [groundRestriction_mulVec, Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, dite_eq_right hi, Pi.single_apply,
      ite_eq_right hi, mul_zero, add_zero] using h

private theorem vector_split (b : V → ℝ) :
    b = zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (fun i => b i.val) + b r • Pi.single r 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    simp
  · simp [zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, hi]

private theorem pivot_action (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    degreeOnePivot A r u *ᵥ z = A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z -
      ((A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r * z u) • Pi.single u 1 := by
  rw [pivot_rank, sub_mulVec, smul_mulVec, vecMulVec_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

/-- The computed sparse primitive transports the full residual for every retained candidate.
No correctness assumption on a lower solve is required. -/
theorem degreeOneLift_residual (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (b : V → ℝ) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    A *ᵥ degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) - b =
      zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (degreeOnePivot A r u *ᵥ z - degreeOneRHS A r u b) := by
  rw [lift_add, mulVec_add, mulVec_smul, action_split A r u hs z,
    column_action A r u hA hs]
  conv_lhs => rhs; rw [vector_split r b]
  simp only [pivot_action, rhs_sub, mulVec_sub, mulVec_smul, zeroInsertion_single]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [hp]
  ring

/-- Back substitution keeps every retained candidate coordinate literally. -/
theorem degreeOneLift_restrict (b : V → ℝ) (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) = z := by
  rw [groundRestriction_mulVec]
  ext i
  exact degreeOneLift_retained A r u b z i

private theorem liftMatrix_mulVec (z : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    liftMatrix A r u *ᵥ z = degreeOneLift A r u (0, z) := by
  rw [liftMatrix, sub_mulVec, smul_mulVec, vecMulVec_mulVec, lift_add]
  ext i
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, sub_eq_add_neg]

private theorem restriction_liftMatrix : groundRestriction r * liftMatrix A r u = 1 := by
  apply ext_of_mulVec_single
  intro i
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, liftMatrix_mulVec, degreeOneLift_restrict, one_mulVec]

private theorem source_liftMatrix (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0) :
    A * liftMatrix A r u = zeroInsertion r * degreeOnePivot A r u := by
  apply ext_of_mulVec_single
  intro i
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, ← mulVec_mulVec, liftMatrix_mulVec]
  have h := degreeOneLift_residual A r u hA hs hp 0 (Pi.single i 1)
  simpa only [map_zero, sub_zero] using h

private theorem liftMatrix_congruence (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0) :
    (liftMatrix A r u)ᴴ * A * liftMatrix A r u = degreeOnePivot A r u := by
  have ht : (liftMatrix A r u)ᵀ * zeroInsertion r = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose (restriction_liftMatrix A r u)
    simpa only [transpose_mul, transpose_one, zeroInsertion] using h
  rw [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_assoc, source_liftMatrix A r u hA hs hp,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ht, one_mul]

omit [Fintype V] in
private theorem pivot_posDef [Finite V] (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) : (degreeOnePivot A r u).PosDef := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have hinj : Function.Injective (liftMatrix A r u).mulVec := by
    intro z w hzw
    have h := congrArg (fun x => groundRestriction r *ᵥ x) hzw
    simpa only [mulVec_mulVec, restriction_liftMatrix, one_mulVec] using h
  have h := hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj
  rwa [liftMatrix_congruence A r u hA.isHermitian hs (ne_of_gt hA.diag_pos)] at h

/-- Differences of back-substituted candidates have exactly the computed reduced energy. -/
theorem degreeOneLift_error_energy (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (b : V → ℝ) (z w : {v : V // v ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    (degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) - degreeOneLift A r u (b, w)) ⬝ᵥ
        (A *ᵥ (degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) - degreeOneLift A r u (b, w))) =
      (z - w) ⬝ᵥ (degreeOnePivot A r u *ᵥ (z - w)) := by
  have hd : degreeOneLift A r u (b, z) - degreeOneLift A r u (b, w) =
      liftMatrix A r u *ᵥ (z - w) := by
    rw [liftMatrix_mulVec, ← map_sub]
    simp only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self]
  rw [hd]
  calc
    (liftMatrix A r u *ᵥ (z - w)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (liftMatrix A r u *ᵥ (z - w))) =
        (z - w) ⬝ᵥ ((liftMatrix A r u)ᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (liftMatrix A r u *ᵥ (z - w)))) := by
      exact (dotProduct_comm _ _).trans
        (by simpa only [transpose_transpose] using
          dotProduct_transpose_mulVec (liftMatrix A r u)ᵀ (A *ᵥ (liftMatrix A r u *ᵥ (z - w))) (z - w))
    _ = (z - w) ⬝ᵥ (((liftMatrix A r u)ᴴ * A * liftMatrix A r u) *ᵥ (z - w)) := by
      rw [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec]
    _ = (z - w) ⬝ᵥ (degreeOnePivot A r u *ᵥ (z - w)) := by
      rw [liftMatrix_congruence A r u hA hs hp]

private theorem sum_delete (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : {v : V // v ≠ r}, f i.val) = (∑ i, f i) - f r := by
  have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne f r
  linarith only [h]

omit [DecidableEq V] in
/-- The original pivot surplus is its full diagonal plus its one off-diagonal entry. -/
theorem degreeOnePivot_surplus
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) :
    (∑ j, A r j) = A r r + A r u.val := by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (fun j => A r j) r]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single u
  · intro j _ hju
    exact hs j.val j.property (fun h => hju (Subtype.ext h))
  · simp

/-- The computed reduced row sums retain and transfer the original diagonal surplus. -/
theorem degreeOnePivot_rowSum (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (i : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    (∑ j, degreeOnePivot A r u i j) = (∑ j, A i.val j) -
      if i = u then (A r u.val / A r r) * ∑ j, A r j else 0 := by
  by_cases hi : i = u
  · subst i
    have hsum : (∑ j, degreeOnePivot A r u u j) =
        (∑ j : {v : V // v ≠ r}, A u.val j.val) - (A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r := by
      simp [degreeOnePivot_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hcol : A u.val r = A r u.val := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.apply r u.val
    rw [hsum, sum_delete r (fun j => A u.val j), hcol,
      degreeOnePivot_surplus A r u hs]
    simp only [ite_true]
    field_simp [hp]
    ring
  · have hcol : A i.val r = 0 := by
      have h := hA.apply r i.val
      simpa only [star_trivial, hs i.val i.property (fun h => hi (Subtype.ext h))] using h
    simp only [degreeOnePivot_apply, hi, false_and, ite_false, sub_zero,
      sum_delete r (fun j => A i.val j), hcol]

/-- The actual degree-one update preserves positive definiteness, nonpositive off-diagonals,
and nonnegative row sums, the native matrix conditions defining SDDM. -/
theorem degreeOnePivot_preserves_sddm (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → A i j ≤ 0) (hrows : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ∑ j, A i j)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) :
    (degreeOnePivot A r u).PosDef ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → degreeOnePivot A r u i j ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, 0 ≤ ∑ j, degreeOnePivot A r u i j := by
  have hp : 0 < A r r := hA.diag_pos
  have hq : A r u.val ≤ 0 := hoff r u.val (Ne.symm u.property)
  refine ⟨pivot_posDef A r u hA hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    rw [degreeOnePivot_apply_of_ne A r u hij]
    exact hoff i.val j.val (fun h => hij (Subtype.ext h))
  · intro i
    rw [degreeOnePivot_rowSum A r u hA.isHermitian hs (ne_of_gt hp) i]
    by_cases hi : i = u
    · rw [ite_eq_left hi]
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr (le_trans
        (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hq hp.le) (hrows r))
        (hrows i.val))
    · simpa only [ite_eq_right hi, sub_zero] using hrows i.val

private theorem restriction_root_single : groundRestriction r *ᵥ Pi.single r 1 = 0 := by
  rw [groundRestriction_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [i.property]

private theorem restriction_single (j : {v : V // v ≠ r}) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ Pi.single j.val 1 = Pi.single j 1 := by
  rw [groundRestriction_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [Pi.single_apply, Subtype.val_injective.eq_iff]

private theorem embedding_apply (M : Matrix {v : V // v ≠ r} {v : V // v ≠ r} ℝ)
    (i j : V) :
    (zeroInsertion r * M * groundRestriction r) i j =
      if hi : i = r then 0 else if hj : j = r then 0 else M ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  have h : (zeroInsertion r * M * groundRestriction r) i j =
      (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (M *ᵥ (groundRestriction r *ᵥ Pi.single j 1))) i := by
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_single_one]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    simp
  · by_cases hj : j = r
    · subst j
      rw [restriction_root_single, mulVec_zero, mulVec_zero]
      simp [hi]
    · have hg := restriction_single r (⟨j, hj⟩ : {v : V // v ≠ r})
      rw [hg, mulVec_single_one, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply]
      simp only [dite_eq_right hi, dite_eq_right hj]
      rfl

/-- The computed two-coordinate column and computed reduced matrix give the actual
one-pivot normalized Cholesky factorization in the original coordinates. -/
theorem degreeOnePivot_factor (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → A r j = 0) (hp : 0 < A r r) :
    A = vecMulVec (degreeOneColumn A r u) (degreeOneColumn A r u) +
      zeroInsertion r * degreeOnePivot A r u * groundRestriction r := by
  let s := Real.sqrt (A r r)
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = A r r := Real.sq_sqrt hp.le
  have hcross : s * (A r u.val / s) = A r u.val := by
    field_simp [hs0]
  have hratio : (A r u.val / s) ^ 2 = (A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r := by
    rw [div_pow, ← hs2]
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.add_apply, vecMulVec_apply, embedding_apply]
  simp only [degreeOneColumn, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change A i j =
    (s * (Pi.single r 1 : V → ℝ) i + (A r u.val / s) * (Pi.single u.val 1 : V → ℝ) i) *
      (s * (Pi.single r 1 : V → ℝ) j + (A r u.val / s) * (Pi.single u.val 1 : V → ℝ) j) +
      (if hi : i = r then 0 else if hj : j = r then 0 else degreeOnePivot A r u ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩)
  by_cases hir : i = r
  · subst i
    by_cases hjr : j = r
    · subst j
      simpa [Ne.symm u.property, pow_two] using hs2.symm
    · by_cases hju : j = u.val
      · subst j
        simpa [Ne.symm u.property, u.property] using hcross.symm
      · simp [hjr, hju, Ne.symm u.property, hs j hjr hju]
  · by_cases hjr : j = r
    · subst j
      have hh : A i r = A r i := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.apply r i
      rw [hh]
      by_cases hiu : i = u.val
      · subst i
        simpa [Ne.symm u.property, u.property, mul_comm] using hcross.symm
      · simp [hir, hiu, Ne.symm u.property, hs i hir hiu]
    · rw [dite_eq_right hir, dite_eq_right hjr, pivot_rank]
      simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, vecMulVec_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, Pi.single_apply, Subtype.ext_iff, ite_eq_right hir, ite_eq_right hjr,
        mul_zero, zero_add]
      have h := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t * (if i = u.val then 1 else 0) *
        (if j = u.val then 1 else 0)) hratio
      linear_combination -h

/-- The support bound concerns the actual column in `degreeOnePivot_factor`. -/
theorem degreeOneColumn_support_card :
    ((univ : Finset V).filter fun i => degreeOneColumn A r u i ≠ 0).card ≤ 2 := by
  have hsub : (univ : Finset V).filter (fun i => degreeOneColumn A r u i ≠ 0) ⊆ {r, u.val} := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra h
    have hir : i ≠ r := by simpa using (not_or.mp (by simpa using h)).1
    have hiu : i ≠ u.val := by simpa using (not_or.mp (by simpa using h)).2
    exact (mem_filter.mp hi).2 (degreeOneColumn_eq_zero A r u hir hiu)
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (by simp [Ne.symm u.property])

end Matrix
