module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GroundCoordinates
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
public import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination

/-!
# SDDM elimination with two retained neighbors

For two distinct retained neighbor indices, the primitive computes four matrix-entry
corrections, two right-hand-side corrections, and back substitution from the original matrix.
Every denominator is the full original pivot diagonal, including its diagonal surplus.

The construction is the degree-two step of Spielman and Teng, *Nearly-Linear Time Algorithms
for Preconditioning and Solving Symmetric, Diagonally Dominant Linear Systems*, arXiv
cs/0607105v5, current typesetting 26 November 2024, §§1.1, 3.1, 4.1 and 5. This is one
numerical primitive, not the complete sparse state, pivot queue, factor chain or cost proof.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Finset
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Matrix

variable {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]

/-- The four retained-entry corrections for two distinct neighbor indices. -/
def degreeTwoPivot (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u v : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    Matrix {i : V // i ≠ r} {i : V // i ≠ r} ℝ :=
  fun i j => A i.val j.val -
    if i = u ∧ j = u then (A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r
    else if i = v ∧ j = v then (A r v.val) ^ 2 / A r r
    else if (i = u ∧ j = v) ∨ (i = v ∧ j = u) then A r u.val * A r v.val / A r r
    else 0

/-- Forward substitution computes the two retained right-hand-side corrections. -/
def degreeTwoRHS (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u v : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    (V → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) where
  toFun b i := b i.val - (if i = u then A r u.val * b r / A r r else 0) -
    (if i = v then A r v.val * b r / A r r else 0)
  map_add' b c := by
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  map_smul' k b := by
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring

/-- Back substitution is linear in the original right-hand side and retained candidate. -/
def degreeTwoLift (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u v : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    (V → ℝ) × ({i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (V → ℝ) where
  toFun bz i := if hi : i = r then
      (bz.1 r - A r u.val * bz.2 u - A r v.val * bz.2 v) / A r r
    else bz.2 ⟨i, hi⟩
  map_add' bz cw := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst i
      simp
      ring
    · simp [hi]
  map_smul' k bz := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst i
      simp
      ring
    · simp [hi]

/-- The normalized source column, computed from the original pivot and couplings. -/
def degreeTwoColumn (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u v : {i : V // i ≠ r}) : V → ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (A r r) • Pi.single r 1 +
    (A r u.val / Real.sqrt (A r r)) • Pi.single u.val 1 +
    (A r v.val / Real.sqrt (A r r)) • Pi.single v.val 1

variable (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (r : V) (u v : {i : V // i ≠ r})

@[simp]
theorem degreeTwoPivot_apply (i j : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    degreeTwoPivot A r u v i j = A i.val j.val -
      if i = u ∧ j = u then (A r u.val) ^ 2 / A r r
      else if i = v ∧ j = v then (A r v.val) ^ 2 / A r r
      else if (i = u ∧ j = v) ∨ (i = v ∧ j = u) then A r u.val * A r v.val / A r r
      else 0 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem degreeTwoRHS_apply (b : V → ℝ) (i : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    degreeTwoRHS A r u v b i =
      b i.val - (if i = u then A r u.val * b r / A r r else 0) -
        (if i = v then A r v.val * b r / A r r else 0) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem degreeTwoLift_root (b : V → ℝ) (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) r =
      (b r - A r u.val * z u - A r v.val * z v) / A r r := by
  simp [degreeTwoLift]

@[simp]
theorem degreeTwoLift_retained (b : V → ℝ) (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ)
    (i : {i : V // i ≠ r}) : degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) i.val = z i := by
  simp [degreeTwoLift, i.property]

theorem degreeTwoColumn_eq_zero {i : V} (hir : i ≠ r) (hiu : i ≠ u.val) (hiv : i ≠ v.val) :
    degreeTwoColumn A r u v i = 0 := by
  simp [degreeTwoColumn, hir, hiu, hiv]

private def coupling : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ :=
  A r u.val • Pi.single u 1 + A r v.val • Pi.single v 1

private theorem coupling_apply (i : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    coupling A r u v i = (if i = u then A r u.val else 0) +
      (if i = v then A r v.val else 0) := by
  simp [coupling, Pi.single_apply]

private theorem row_restricted (hne : u ≠ v)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) :
    (fun i : {i : V // i ≠ r} => A r i.val) = coupling A r u v := by
  ext i
  by_cases hiu : i = u
  · subst i
    simp [coupling_apply, hne]
  · by_cases hiv : i = v
    · subst i
      simp [coupling_apply, Ne.symm hne]
    · have hiu' : i.val ≠ u.val := fun h => hiu (Subtype.ext h)
      have hiv' : i.val ≠ v.val := fun h => hiv (Subtype.ext h)
      simp [coupling_apply, hiu, hiv, hs i.val i.property hiu' hiv']

private theorem pivot_rank (hne : u ≠ v) : degreeTwoPivot A r u v =
    A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val -
      (A r r)⁻¹ • vecMulVec (coupling A r u v) (coupling A r u v) := by
  ext i j
  by_cases hiu : i = u <;> by_cases hiv : i = v <;>
    by_cases hju : j = u <;> by_cases hjv : j = v <;>
    simp_all [degreeTwoPivot, coupling_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      vecMulVec_apply, div_eq_mul_inv] <;> ring

/-- Express the four sparse corrections as one rank-one matrix correction. -/
theorem degreeTwoPivot_eq_sub_rankOne (hne : u ≠ v) : degreeTwoPivot A r u v =
    A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val -
      (A r r)⁻¹ • vecMulVec
        (A r u.val • Pi.single u 1 + A r v.val • Pi.single v 1)
        (A r u.val • Pi.single u 1 + A r v.val • Pi.single v 1) := by
  exact pivot_rank A r u v hne

private theorem rhs_sub (b : V → ℝ) : degreeTwoRHS A r u v b =
    (fun i => b i.val) - (b r / A r r) • coupling A r u v := by
  ext i
  change b i.val - (if i = u then A r u.val * b r / A r r else 0) -
    (if i = v then A r v.val * b r / A r r else 0) =
      b i.val - (b r / A r r) * coupling A r u v i
  rw [coupling_apply]
  split_ifs <;> ring

private def liftMatrix : Matrix V {i : V // i ≠ r} ℝ :=
  zeroInsertion r - (A r r)⁻¹ • vecMulVec (Pi.single r 1) (coupling A r u v)

variable [Fintype V]

private theorem coupling_dot (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    coupling A r u v ⬝ᵥ z = A r u.val * z u + A r v.val * z v := by
  simp [coupling, add_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct]

private theorem lift_add (b : V → ℝ) (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) = zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z +
      ((b r - coupling A r u v ⬝ᵥ z) / A r r) • Pi.single r 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    rw [degreeTwoLift_root]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, zeroInsertion_mulVec_root]
    rw [coupling_dot]
    simp
    ring
  · simp [degreeTwoLift, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, hi]

private theorem principal_action (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) =
      A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z := by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, groundRestriction_mul_mul_zeroInsertion]

private theorem pivot_row_action (hne : u ≠ v)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0)
    (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    (A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z)) r = coupling A r u v ⬝ᵥ z := by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one]
  have hm := mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl V) (Subtype.val : {i : V // i ≠ r} → V) A
  simp only [Equiv.coe_refl, Equiv.refl_symm, Function.id_comp] at hm
  rw [hm]
  change (fun i : {i : V // i ≠ r} => A r i.val) ⬝ᵥ z = coupling A r u v ⬝ᵥ z
  rw [row_restricted A r u v hne hs]

private theorem column_action (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) :
    A *ᵥ Pi.single r 1 = A r r • Pi.single r 1 + zeroInsertion r *ᵥ coupling A r u v := by
  rw [mulVec_single_one]
  ext i
  have hh : A i r = A r i := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.apply r i
  change A i r = A r r * (Pi.single r 1 : V → ℝ) i +
    (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ coupling A r u v) i
  rw [hh]
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    simp
  · have h := congrArg (fun x : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ => x ⟨i, hi⟩)
      (row_restricted A r u v hne hs)
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply,
      dite_eq_right hi, Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right hi, mul_zero, zero_add] using h

private theorem action_split (hne : u ≠ v)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0)
    (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    A *ᵥ (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ z) =
      zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z) +
        (coupling A r u v ⬝ᵥ z) • Pi.single r 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    rw [pivot_row_action A r u v hne hs z, Pi.add_apply, zeroInsertion_mulVec_root]
    simp
  · have h := congrArg (fun x : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ => x ⟨i, hi⟩)
      (principal_action A r z)
    simpa only [groundRestriction_mulVec, Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, dite_eq_right hi, Pi.single_apply,
      ite_eq_right hi, mul_zero, add_zero] using h

private theorem vector_split (b : V → ℝ) :
    b = zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (fun i => b i.val) + b r • Pi.single r 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    simp
  · simp [zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, hi]

private theorem pivot_action (hne : u ≠ v) (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    degreeTwoPivot A r u v *ᵥ z = A.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val *ᵥ z -
      ((coupling A r u v ⬝ᵥ z) / A r r) • coupling A r u v := by
  rw [pivot_rank A r u v hne, sub_mulVec, smul_mulVec, vecMulVec_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

/-- The computed numerical primitive transports the full residual for every candidate. -/
theorem degreeTwoLift_residual (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (b : V → ℝ) (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    A *ᵥ degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) - b =
      zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (degreeTwoPivot A r u v *ᵥ z - degreeTwoRHS A r u v b) := by
  rw [lift_add, mulVec_add, mulVec_smul, action_split A r u v hne hs z,
    column_action A r u v hne hA hs]
  conv_lhs => rhs; rw [vector_split r b]
  simp only [pivot_action A r u v hne, rhs_sub, mulVec_sub, mulVec_smul]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [hp]
  ring

/-- Reconstruction preserves every retained candidate coordinate. -/
theorem degreeTwoLift_restrict (b : V → ℝ) (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) = z := by
  rw [groundRestriction_mulVec]
  ext i
  exact degreeTwoLift_retained A r u v b z i

private theorem liftMatrix_mulVec (z : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    liftMatrix A r u v *ᵥ z = degreeTwoLift A r u v (0, z) := by
  rw [liftMatrix, sub_mulVec, smul_mulVec, vecMulVec_mulVec, lift_add]
  ext i
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, sub_eq_add_neg]

private theorem restriction_liftMatrix :
    groundRestriction r * liftMatrix A r u v = 1 := by
  apply ext_of_mulVec_single
  intro i
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, liftMatrix_mulVec, degreeTwoLift_restrict, one_mulVec]

private theorem source_liftMatrix (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0) :
    A * liftMatrix A r u v = zeroInsertion r * degreeTwoPivot A r u v := by
  apply ext_of_mulVec_single
  intro i
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, ← mulVec_mulVec, liftMatrix_mulVec]
  have h := degreeTwoLift_residual A r u v hne hA hs hp 0 (Pi.single i 1)
  simpa only [map_zero, sub_zero] using h

private theorem liftMatrix_congruence (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0) :
    (liftMatrix A r u v)ᴴ * A * liftMatrix A r u v = degreeTwoPivot A r u v := by
  have ht : (liftMatrix A r u v)ᵀ * zeroInsertion r = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose (restriction_liftMatrix A r u v)
    simpa only [transpose_mul, transpose_one, zeroInsertion] using h
  rw [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    source_liftMatrix A r u v hne hA hs hp, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ht, one_mul]

omit [Fintype V] in
private theorem pivot_posDef [Finite V] (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) :
    (degreeTwoPivot A r u v).PosDef := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have hinj : Function.Injective (liftMatrix A r u v).mulVec := by
    intro z w hzw
    have h := congrArg (fun x => groundRestriction r *ᵥ x) hzw
    simpa only [mulVec_mulVec, restriction_liftMatrix, one_mulVec] using h
  have h := hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj
  rwa [liftMatrix_congruence A r u v hne hA.isHermitian hs (ne_of_gt hA.diag_pos)] at h

/-- Two reconstructions with the same right-hand side have exactly the reduced error energy. -/
theorem degreeTwoLift_error_energy (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (b : V → ℝ) (z w : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ) :
    (degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) - degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, w)) ⬝ᵥ
        (A *ᵥ (degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) - degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, w))) =
      (z - w) ⬝ᵥ (degreeTwoPivot A r u v *ᵥ (z - w)) := by
  have hd : degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, z) - degreeTwoLift A r u v (b, w) =
      liftMatrix A r u v *ᵥ (z - w) := by
    rw [liftMatrix_mulVec, ← map_sub]
    simp only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self]
  rw [hd]
  calc
    (liftMatrix A r u v *ᵥ (z - w)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (liftMatrix A r u v *ᵥ (z - w))) =
        (z - w) ⬝ᵥ ((liftMatrix A r u v)ᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (liftMatrix A r u v *ᵥ (z - w)))) := by
      exact (dotProduct_comm _ _).trans
        (by simpa only [transpose_transpose] using
          (dotProduct_transpose_mulVec (liftMatrix A r u v)ᵀ
            (A *ᵥ (liftMatrix A r u v *ᵥ (z - w))) (z - w)))
    _ = (z - w) ⬝ᵥ (((liftMatrix A r u v)ᴴ * A * liftMatrix A r u v) *ᵥ (z - w)) := by
      rw [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec]
    _ = (z - w) ⬝ᵥ (degreeTwoPivot A r u v *ᵥ (z - w)) := by
      rw [liftMatrix_congruence A r u v hne hA hs hp]

private theorem sum_delete (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : {j : V // j ≠ r}, f i.val) = (∑ i, f i) - f r := by
  have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne f r
  linarith only [h]

private theorem coupling_sum :
    (∑ i, coupling A r u v i) = A r u.val + A r v.val := by
  simp [coupling, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Pi.single_apply]

omit [DecidableEq V] in
/-- The actual original pivot surplus includes both off-diagonal couplings. -/
theorem degreeTwoPivot_surplus (hne : u ≠ v)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) :
    (∑ j, A r j) = A r r + A r u.val + A r v.val := by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (fun j => A r j) r]
  change A r r + (∑ i : {j : V // j ≠ r}, (fun i => A r i.val) i) =
    A r r + A r u.val + A r v.val
  rw [row_restricted A r u v hne hs, coupling_sum]
  ring

private theorem rowSum_internal (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (i : {j : V // j ≠ r}) :
    (∑ j, degreeTwoPivot A r u v i j) = (∑ j, A i.val j) -
      (coupling A r u v i / A r r) * ∑ j, A r j := by
  have hcol : A i.val r = coupling A r u v i := by
    have hh : A i.val r = A r i.val := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.apply r i.val
    exact hh.trans (congrArg (fun f : {j : V // j ≠ r} → ℝ => f i)
      (row_restricted A r u v hne hs))
  have hcorr : (∑ j, (A r r)⁻¹ * (coupling A r u v i * coupling A r u v j)) =
      (A r r)⁻¹ * coupling A r u v i * (A r u.val + A r v.val) := by
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum, coupling_sum]
  rw [pivot_rank A r u v hne]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    vecMulVec_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hcorr, sum_delete r (fun j => A i.val j), hcol, degreeTwoPivot_surplus A r u v hne hs]
  field_simp [hp]
  ring

/-- Both neighbor row sums retain their original surplus and receive their share of the
eliminated pivot surplus. All other retained row sums are unchanged. -/
theorem degreeTwoPivot_rowSum (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : A r r ≠ 0)
    (i : {j : V // j ≠ r}) :
    (∑ j, degreeTwoPivot A r u v i j) = (∑ j, A i.val j) -
      (if i = u then A r u.val / A r r else 0) * (∑ j, A r j) -
      (if i = v then A r v.val / A r r else 0) * (∑ j, A r j) := by
  rw [rowSum_internal A r u v hne hA hs hp i, coupling_apply]
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- The computed two-neighbor update preserves the native matrix conditions of SDDM. -/
theorem degreeTwoPivot_preserves_sddm (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.PosDef)
    (hoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → A i j ≤ 0) (hrows : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ∑ j, A i j)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) :
    (degreeTwoPivot A r u v).PosDef ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → degreeTwoPivot A r u v i j ≤ 0) ∧
      ∀ i, 0 ≤ ∑ j, degreeTwoPivot A r u v i j := by
  have hp : 0 < A r r := hA.diag_pos
  have hw (i : {j : V // j ≠ r}) : coupling A r u v i ≤ 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : {j : V // j ≠ r} → ℝ => f i)
      (row_restricted A r u v hne hs)
    rw [← h]
    exact hoff r i.val (Ne.symm i.property)
  refine ⟨pivot_posDef A r u v hne hA hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    rw [pivot_rank A r u v hne]
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      vecMulVec_apply]
    exact sub_nonpos.mpr (le_trans (hoff i.val j.val (fun h => hij (Subtype.ext h)))
      (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hp.le) (mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (hw i) (hw j))))
  · intro i
    rw [rowSum_internal A r u v hne hA.isHermitian hs (ne_of_gt hp) i]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (le_trans
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hw i) hp.le) (hrows r))
      (hrows i.val))

private theorem zeroInsertion_single (j : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (Pi.single j 1) = Pi.single j.val 1 := by
  ext i
  simp [zeroInsertion_eq_submatrix_one, mulVec_single, Matrix.one_apply, Pi.single_apply]

private theorem column_decomp : degreeTwoColumn A r u v =
    Real.sqrt (A r r) • Pi.single r 1 +
      (Real.sqrt (A r r))⁻¹ • (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ coupling A r u v) := by
  rw [coupling, mulVec_add, mulVec_smul, mulVec_smul, zeroInsertion_single, zeroInsertion_single]
  ext i
  simp only [degreeTwoColumn, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

private theorem restriction_root_single : groundRestriction r *ᵥ Pi.single r 1 = 0 := by
  rw [groundRestriction_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [i.property]

private theorem restriction_single (j : {i : V // i ≠ r}) :
    groundRestriction r *ᵥ Pi.single j.val 1 = Pi.single j 1 := by
  rw [groundRestriction_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [Pi.single_apply, Subtype.val_injective.eq_iff]

private theorem embedding_apply (M : Matrix {i : V // i ≠ r} {i : V // i ≠ r} ℝ)
    (i j : V) :
    (zeroInsertion r * M * groundRestriction r) i j =
      if hi : i = r then 0 else if hj : j = r then 0 else M ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  have h : (zeroInsertion r * M * groundRestriction r) i j =
      (zeroInsertion r *ᵥ (M *ᵥ (groundRestriction r *ᵥ Pi.single j 1))) i := by
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_single_one]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst i
    simp
  · by_cases hj : j = r
    · subst j
      rw [restriction_root_single, mulVec_zero, mulVec_zero]
      simp [hi]
    · have hg := restriction_single r (⟨j, hj⟩ : {i : V // i ≠ r})
      rw [hg, mulVec_single_one, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply]
      simp only [dite_eq_right hi, dite_eq_right hj]
      rfl

/-- The actual normalized three-coordinate column and actual reduced matrix factor the
original input matrix in its original coordinates. -/
theorem degreeTwoPivot_factor (hne : u ≠ v) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hs : ∀ j, j ≠ r → j ≠ u.val → j ≠ v.val → A r j = 0) (hp : 0 < A r r) :
    A = vecMulVec (degreeTwoColumn A r u v) (degreeTwoColumn A r u v) +
      zeroInsertion r * degreeTwoPivot A r u v * groundRestriction r := by
  let s := Real.sqrt (A r r)
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = A r r := Real.sq_sqrt hp.le
  have hratio : (s⁻¹) ^ 2 = (A r r)⁻¹ := by rw [← hs2, inv_pow]
  have hroot : degreeTwoColumn A r u v r = s := by
    rw [column_decomp]
    simp [s]
  have hret (i : V) (hi : i ≠ r) : degreeTwoColumn A r u v i =
      s⁻¹ * coupling A r u v ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
    rw [column_decomp]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.single_apply,
      ite_eq_right hi, mul_zero, zero_add, zeroInsertion_mulVec_apply, dite_eq_right hi]
    rfl
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.add_apply, vecMulVec_apply, embedding_apply]
  by_cases hir : i = r
  · subst i
    by_cases hjr : j = r
    · subst j
      simpa [hroot, pow_two] using hs2.symm
    · have hrow := congrArg (fun f : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ => f ⟨j, hjr⟩)
        (row_restricted A r u v hne hs)
      rw [hroot, hret j hjr, dite_eq_left rfl, add_zero, hrow]
      field_simp [hs0]
  · by_cases hjr : j = r
    · subst j
      have hh : A i r = A r i := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.apply r i
      have hrow := congrArg (fun f : {i : V // i ≠ r} → ℝ => f ⟨i, hir⟩)
        (row_restricted A r u v hne hs)
      rw [hret i hir, hroot, dite_eq_right hir, dite_eq_left rfl, add_zero, hh, hrow]
      field_simp [hs0]
    · rw [hret i hir, hret j hjr, dite_eq_right hir, dite_eq_right hjr, pivot_rank A r u v hne]
      simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        vecMulVec_apply]
      have h := congrArg (fun a : ℝ => a * coupling A r u v ⟨i, hir⟩ *
        coupling A r u v ⟨j, hjr⟩) hratio
      linear_combination -h

/-- The cardinality bound is for the actual factor column in `degreeTwoPivot_factor`. -/
theorem degreeTwoColumn_support_card :
    ((univ : Finset V).filter fun i => degreeTwoColumn A r u v i ≠ 0).card ≤ 3 := by
  have hsub : (univ : Finset V).filter (fun i => degreeTwoColumn A r u v i ≠ 0) ⊆
      {r, u.val, v.val} := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra h
    have hout : i ≠ r ∧ i ≠ u.val ∧ i ≠ v.val := by simpa using h
    exact (mem_filter.mp hi).2 (degreeTwoColumn_eq_zero A r u v hout.1 hout.2.1 hout.2.2)
  have hcard : ({r, u.val, v.val} : Finset V).card ≤ 3 := by
    have h₁ := Finset.card_insert_le r ({u.val, v.val} : Finset V)
    have h₂ := Finset.card_insert_le u.val ({v.val} : Finset V)
    simpa using h₁.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right h₂ 1)
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans hcard

end Matrix

Author: @toskua

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Units.Defs

/-!
# A native block involution from an actual split rectangular pair

For U*V=1, the block matrix [[0,U],[V,1−V*U]] is its own inverse.
The entries stay in an arbitrary noncommutative ring. The construction
uses native Matrix.fromBlocks and multiplication; no inverse matrix or
comparison is supplied as data.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Matrix

universe a n m t

variable {A : Type a} [Ring A]
  {N : Type n} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
  {M : Type m} [Fintype M] [DecidableEq M]
  (U : Matrix N M A) (V : Matrix M N A)

/-- The actual native block matrix for a rectangular pair. -/
def splitInvolution : Matrix (N ⊕ M) (N ⊕ M) A :=
  fromBlocks 0 U V (1 - V * U)
omit [DecidableEq M] in
/-- The complementary block comes from an actual idempotent. -/
theorem splitPair_idempotent (h : U * V = 1) : (V * U) * (V * U) = V * U := by
  calc
    _ = V * (U * (V * U)) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ = V * ((U * V) * U) :=
      congrArg (fun x : Matrix N M A => V * x) (Matrix.mul_assoc U V U).symm
    _ = (V * (U * V)) * U := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [h, Matrix.mul_one]

/-- The top-right block cancels in the square, in the original product order. -/
theorem splitPair_right_zero (h : U * V = 1) : U * (1 - V * U) = 0 := by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, h, Matrix.one_mul, sub_self]

/-- The bottom-left block cancels without commuting any ring elements. -/
theorem splitPair_left_zero (h : U * V = 1) : (1 - V * U) * V = 0 := by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, h, Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]

/-- The bottom-right block of the square is the actual identity. -/
theorem splitPair_complement (h : U * V = 1) :
    V * U + (1 - V * U) * (1 - V * U) = 1 := by
  have hp := splitPair_idempotent U V h
  have hq : (1 - V * U) * (1 - V * U) = 1 - V * U := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
      hp, sub_self, sub_zero]
  rw [hq, add_comm, sub_add_cancel]

/-- The complete actual block matrix is an involution. -/
theorem splitInvolution_mul_self (h : U * V = 1) :
    splitInvolution U V * splitInvolution U V = 1 := by
  rw [splitInvolution, fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.mul_zero, zero_add]
  rw [h, splitPair_right_zero U V h, splitPair_left_zero U V h,
    splitPair_complement U V h, fromBlocks_one]

/-- The native unit has the same explicit matrix as both value and inverse. -/
def splitInvolutionUnit (h : U * V = 1) : (Matrix (N ⊕ M) (N ⊕ M) A)ˣ where
  val := splitInvolution U V
  inv := splitInvolution U V
  val_inv := splitInvolution_mul_self U V h
  inv_val := splitInvolution_mul_self U V h

@[simp]
theorem splitInvolutionUnit_val (h : U * V = 1) :
    (splitInvolutionUnit U V h).val = splitInvolution U V := rfl

-- keeps the stored inverse-field getter for rw; Units.inv_eq_val_inv simplifies its left-hand
-- side
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem splitInvolutionUnit_inv (h : U * V = 1) :
    (splitInvolutionUnit U V h).inv = splitInvolution U V := rfl

section Row

variable {J : Type m} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (u v : J → A)

/-- The actual one-row matrix of the normalized family. -/
def normalizedRow : Matrix PUnit J A := Matrix.of (fun _ j => u j)

/-- The actual one-column matrix, with no transposed product convention. -/
def normalizedColumn : Matrix J PUnit A := Matrix.of (fun j _ => v j)
omit [DecidableEq J] in
theorem normalizedRow_mul_column (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1) :
    normalizedRow u * normalizedColumn v = 1 := by
  ext i j
  cases i
  cases j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  change (∑ t : J, u t * v t) = 1
  exact h

/-- The normalized family gives a concrete unit indexed by PUnit⊕J, even if J is empty. -/
def normalizedFrameUnit (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1) :
    (Matrix (PUnit ⊕ J) (PUnit ⊕ J) A)ˣ :=
  splitInvolutionUnit (normalizedRow u) (normalizedColumn v)
    (normalizedRow_mul_column u v h)

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_val (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit u v h).val =
      fromBlocks 0 (normalizedRow u) (normalizedColumn v)
        (1 - normalizedColumn v * normalizedRow u) := rfl

-- keeps the stored inverse-field getter for rw; Units.inv_eq_val_inv simplifies its left-hand
-- side
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_inv (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit u v h).inv =
      fromBlocks 0 (normalizedRow u) (normalizedColumn v)
        (1 - normalizedColumn v * normalizedRow u) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_val_inl_inl (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1)
    (i j : PUnit.{t + 1}) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).val (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = 0 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_val_inl_inr (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1)
    (i : PUnit.{t + 1}) (j : J) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).val (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = u j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_val_inr_inl (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1)
    (i : J) (j : PUnit.{t + 1}) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).val (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = v i := rfl

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_inv_inl_inl (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1)
    (i j : PUnit.{t + 1}) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).inv (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) = 0 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_inv_inl_inr (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1)
    (i : PUnit.{t + 1}) (j : J) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).inv (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = u j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_inv_inr_inl (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1)
    (i : J) (j : PUnit.{t + 1}) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).inv (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = v i := rfl

/-- The actual PUnit corner before conjugation. -/
def normalizedFrameCorner (x : A) : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ J) (PUnit ⊕ J) A :=
  fromBlocks (Matrix.of (fun _ _ : PUnit => x)) 0 0 0

/-- Actual conjugation sends the PUnit corner to the computed Peirce block v_i*x*u_j. -/
theorem normalizedFrameUnit_conjugateCorner (h : (∑ j, u j * v j) = 1) (x : A) :
    (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).inv *
        normalizedFrameCorner.{a, m, t} (J := J) x *
        (normalizedFrameUnit.{a, m, t} u v h).val =
      fromBlocks 0 0 0 (Matrix.of (fun i j : J => v i * x * u j)) := by
  rw [normalizedFrameUnit_inv.{a, m, t, t}, normalizedFrameUnit_val.{a, m, t, t},
    normalizedFrameCorner,
    fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
  apply congrArg (fun X : Matrix J J A =>
    fromBlocks (0 : Matrix PUnit PUnit A) (0 : Matrix PUnit J A) (0 : Matrix J PUnit A) X)
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [normalizedRow, normalizedColumn, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fintype.sum_unique]

end Row

end Matrix

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.StableModule

/-!
# Stable nonunital matrix algebras

The algebra is the native `DirectLimit` of finite square matrix algebras under
top-left zero extension. Its nonunital ring and ground module are native
direct-limit structures. The actual identity-on-stages module comparison
identifies it with the coefficient matrix direct limit and hence with literal
finite-support matrix coordinates. No equality of chosen colimit carriers is
assumed, and multiplication always comes from a common finite stage.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Matrix

universe u v

variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (A : Type v) [NonUnitalRing A] [Module k A]

local instance : DirectedSystem (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h) :=
  zeroExtend_directedSystem (k := k) (A := A)

local instance : DirectedSystem (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) (A := A) h) :=
  zeroExtendLinear_directedSystem (k := k) (A := A)

/-- The actual stable nonunital algebra, with native direct-limit multiplication. -/
abbrev Stable : Type v :=
  letI : DirectedSystem (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
      (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h) :=
    zeroExtend_directedSystem (k := k) (A := A)
  DirectLimit (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h)

namespace Stable

/-- The actual native nonunital algebra inclusion of a finite stage. -/
def ofFinite (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A →ₙₐ[k] Stable k A :=
  DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.of (R := k)
    (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h) n

@[simp]
theorem ofFinite_zeroExtend {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    ofFinite k A m (zeroExtend h B) = ofFinite k A n B :=
  DirectLimit.NonUnitalAlgebra.of_f (R := k)
    (G := fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (f := fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h) h B

theorem exists_ofFinite (x : Stable k A) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A), x = ofFinite k A n B :=
  DirectLimit.exists_eq_mk (f := fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h) x

/-- Positive finite stages suffice, including for an element from the size-zero stage. -/
theorem exists_positive_ofFinite (x : Stable k A) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) A), x = ofFinite k A (n + 1) B := by
  obtain ⟨n, B, rfl⟩ := exists_ofFinite k A x
  exact ⟨n, zeroExtend (Nat.le_succ n) B, (ofFinite_zeroExtend k A (Nat.le_succ n) B).symm⟩

/-- The identity-on-stages ground-linear map from the stable algebra to the stable module. -/
def toModule : Stable k A →ₗ[k] StableModule k A :=
  DirectLimit.Module.lift k ℕ
    (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h)
    (fun n => StableModule.ofFinite k A n)
    (fun _ _ h B => StableModule.ofFinite_zeroExtend k A h B)

/-- The identity-on-stages ground-linear map from the stable module to the stable algebra. -/
def fromModule : StableModule k A →ₗ[k] Stable k A :=
  DirectLimit.Module.lift k ℕ
    (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) (A := A) h)
    (fun n => (ofFinite k A n : _ →ₗ[k] _))
    (fun _ _ h B => ofFinite_zeroExtend k A h B)

/-- The forward native colimit map retains its actual finite-stage values. -/
@[simp]
theorem toModule_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    toModule k A (ofFinite k A n B) = StableModule.ofFinite k A n B := rfl

/-- The reverse native colimit map retains its actual finite-stage values. -/
@[simp]
theorem fromModule_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    fromModule k A (StableModule.ofFinite k A n B) = ofFinite k A n B := rfl

/-- The actual identity-on-stages comparison of the native algebra and module colimits. -/
def moduleEquiv : Stable k A ≃ₗ[k] StableModule k A :=
  { toModule k A with
    invFun := fromModule k A
    left_inv x := by
      refine DirectLimit.induction _ (fun n B => ?_) x
      rfl
    right_inv x := by
      refine DirectLimit.induction _ (fun n B => ?_) x
      rfl }

@[simp]
theorem moduleEquiv_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    moduleEquiv k A (ofFinite k A n B) = StableModule.ofFinite k A n B := rfl

@[simp]
theorem moduleEquiv_symm_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    (moduleEquiv k A).symm (StableModule.ofFinite k A n B) = ofFinite k A n B := rfl

/-- Actual entries of the stable algebra, obtained by the earned module comparison. -/
def entries (x : Stable k A) : Matrix ℕ ℕ A := StableModule.entries k A (moduleEquiv k A x)

@[simp]
theorem entries_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) (i j : ℕ) :
    entries k A (ofFinite k A n B) i j =
      if hi : i < n then if hj : j < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0 else 0 := rfl

theorem entries_ofFinite_fin (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) (i j : Fin n) :
    entries k A (ofFinite k A n B) i.val j.val = B i j :=
  StableModule.entries_ofFinite_fin k A n B i j

theorem entries_injective : Function.Injective (entries k A) :=
  (StableModule.entries_injective k A).comp (moduleEquiv k A).injective

/-- Injectivity of finite inclusions is the native direct-limit injectivity criterion. -/
theorem ofFinite_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (ofFinite k A n) :=
  DirectLimit.mk_injective
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendAlgHom (k := k) (A := A) h)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtend_injective (A := A) h) n

theorem entries_bounded (x : Stable k A) :
    ∃ n, ∀ i j : ℕ, n ≤ i ∨ n ≤ j → entries k A x i j = 0 :=
  StableModule.entries_bounded k A (moduleEquiv k A x)

theorem entries_finiteSupport (x : Stable k A) :
    (Function.support (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => entries k A x p.1 p.2)).Finite :=
  StableModule.entries_finiteSupport k A (moduleEquiv k A x)

/-- The actual stable algebra has all, and only, finite-support matrix coordinates. -/
def finsuppEquiv : Stable k A ≃ₗ[k] (ℕ × ℕ) →₀ A :=
  (moduleEquiv k A).trans (StableModule.finsuppEquiv k A)

@[simp]
theorem finsuppEquiv_apply (x : Stable k A) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    finsuppEquiv k A x p = entries k A x p.1 p.2 := rfl

/-- Multiplication is computed in a genuine common finite stage. -/
theorem mul_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    ofFinite k A n B * ofFinite k A n C = ofFinite k A n (B * C) :=
  (map_mul (ofFinite k A n) B C).symm

theorem mul_entries_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) (i j : Fin n) :
    entries k A (ofFinite k A n B * ofFinite k A n C) i.val j.val =
      ∑ p : Fin n, B i p * C p j := by
  rw [mul_ofFinite, entries_ofFinite_fin, Matrix.mul_apply]

end Stable

end Matrix

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ZeroExtension
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Colimit.DirectLimit
public import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Defs
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.Defs
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Equiv.Defs
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold

/-!
# Finite-support coefficient matrices as a native module direct limit

The coefficient module is the actual `DirectLimit` of finite square matrices
under top-left zero extension. Native direct-limit instances give its ground
module structure. Its entries are a faithful map into matrices indexed by the
natural numbers, and every element has support in one finite square.

No ring structure or multiplication on the coefficient carrier is required.
No infinite sum or supplied stable comparison is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Matrix

universe u v

variable (k : Type u) [Semiring k] (A : Type v) [AddCommMonoid A] [Module k A]

local instance : DirectedSystem (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) h) :=
  zeroExtendLinear_directedSystem (k := k) (A := A)

/-- The actual finite-support coefficient module, constructed as the native direct limit. -/
abbrev StableModule : Type v :=
  letI : DirectedSystem (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
      (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) h) :=
    zeroExtendLinear_directedSystem (k := k) (A := A)
  DirectLimit (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) h)

namespace StableModule

/-- The canonical ground-linear inclusion of a finite coefficient matrix stage. -/
def ofFinite (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A →ₗ[k] StableModule k A :=
  DirectLimit.Module.of k ℕ (fun n : ℕ => Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A)
    (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) h) n

@[simp]
theorem ofFinite_zeroExtend {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) :
    ofFinite k A m (zeroExtend h B) = ofFinite k A n B :=
  DirectLimit.Module.of_f (hij := h)

/-- Every stable matrix is represented at a genuine finite stage. -/
theorem exists_ofFinite (x : StableModule k A) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A), x = ofFinite k A n B :=
  DirectLimit.exists_eq_mk (f := fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) (A := A) h) x

/-- The size-zero stage adds no exceptional stable element: positive stages suffice. -/
theorem exists_positive_ofFinite (x : StableModule k A) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) A), x = ofFinite k A (n + 1) B := by
  obtain ⟨n, B, rfl⟩ := exists_ofFinite k A x
  exact ⟨n, zeroExtend (Nat.le_succ n) B, (ofFinite_zeroExtend k A (Nat.le_succ n) B).symm⟩

/-- The natural-number entries of a finite matrix, extended by zero outside its finite square. -/
def finiteEntries {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) : Matrix ℕ ℕ A :=
  Matrix.of fun i j => if hi : i < n then
    if hj : j < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0 else 0

theorem finiteEntries_zeroExtend {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) : finiteEntries A (zeroExtend h B) = finiteEntries A B := by
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · have him : i < m := hi.trans_le h
    by_cases hj : j < n
    · have hjm : j < m := hj.trans_le h
      simp only [finiteEntries, Matrix.of_apply, zeroExtend_apply, hi, hj, him, hjm,
        ↓reduceDIte]
    · by_cases hjm : j < m <;>
        simp only [finiteEntries, Matrix.of_apply, zeroExtend_apply, hi, hj, him, hjm,
          ↓reduceDIte]
  · by_cases him : i < m <;> by_cases hjm : j < m <;>
      simp only [finiteEntries, Matrix.of_apply, zeroExtend_apply, hi, him, hjm, ↓reduceDIte]

/-- Actual natural-number entries of the native direct-limit matrix. -/
def entries : StableModule k A → Matrix ℕ ℕ A :=
  DirectLimit.lift (fun _ _ h => zeroExtendLinear (k := k) (A := A) h)
    (fun _ B => finiteEntries A B)
    (fun _ _ h B => (finiteEntries_zeroExtend A h B).symm)

@[simp]
theorem entries_ofFinite (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) (i j : ℕ) :
    entries k A (ofFinite k A n B) i j =
      if hi : i < n then if hj : j < n then B ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0 else 0 := rfl

theorem entries_ofFinite_fin (n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) (i j : Fin n) :
    entries k A (ofFinite k A n B) i.val j.val = B i j := by
  simp only [entries_ofFinite, dite_eq_left i.is_lt, dite_eq_left j.is_lt]

/-- Entries do not identify distinct stable matrices. -/
theorem entries_injective : Function.Injective (entries k A) := by
  apply DirectLimit.lift_injective
  intro n B C h
  ext i j
  have he := congrArg (fun D : Matrix ℕ ℕ A => D i.val j.val) h
  simpa only [finiteEntries, Matrix.of_apply, dite_eq_left i.is_lt, dite_eq_left j.is_lt] using he

/-- The canonical finite-stage inclusions are injective. -/
theorem ofFinite_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (ofFinite k A n) := by
  intro B C h
  ext i j
  simpa only [entries_ofFinite_fin] using
    congrArg (fun x : StableModule k A => entries k A x i.val j.val) h

/-- Every stable matrix has a finite bound for both its rows and its columns. -/
theorem entries_bounded (x : StableModule k A) :
    ∃ n, ∀ i j : ℕ, n ≤ i ∨ n ≤ j → entries k A x i j = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨n, B, rfl⟩ := exists_ofFinite k A x
  refine ⟨n, fun i j h => ?_⟩
  rcases h with hi | hj
  · rw [entries_ofFinite, dite_eq_right (Nat.not_lt.mpr hi)]
  · by_cases hi : i < n <;>
      simp only [entries_ofFinite, hi, ↓reduceDIte, dite_eq_right (Nat.not_lt.mpr hj)]

/-- The actual natural-number entry function has finite support. -/
theorem entries_finiteSupport (x : StableModule k A) :
    (Function.support (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => entries k A x p.1 p.2)).Finite := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := entries_bounded k A x
  apply ((Finset.range n).product (Finset.range n)).finite_toSet.subset
  intro p hp
  have hrow : p.1 < n := by
    by_contra h
    exact hp (hn p.1 p.2 (Or.inl (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)))
  have hcol : p.2 < n := by
    by_contra h
    exact hp (hn p.1 p.2 (Or.inr (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)))
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hrow, Finset.mem_range.mpr hcol⟩

/-- The finite-support realization uses the native `Finsupp` constructor. -/
def toFinsupp (x : StableModule k A) : (ℕ × ℕ) →₀ A :=
  Finsupp.ofSupportFinite (fun p => entries k A x p.1 p.2) (entries_finiteSupport k A x)

@[simp]
theorem toFinsupp_apply (x : StableModule k A) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    toFinsupp k A x p = entries k A x p.1 p.2 := rfl

theorem toFinsupp_injective : Function.Injective (toFinsupp k A) := by
  intro x y h
  apply entries_injective k A
  ext i j
  exact congrArg (fun f : (ℕ × ℕ) →₀ A => f (i, j)) h

/-- Every finitely supported natural-number matrix comes from an actual finite stage. -/
theorem toFinsupp_surjective : Function.Surjective (toFinsupp k A) := by
  intro f
  let n := f.support.sup (fun p => max p.1 p.2) + 1
  let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A := Matrix.of fun i j => f (i.val, j.val)
  refine ⟨ofFinite k A n B, ?_⟩
  ext p
  change entries k A (ofFinite k A n B) p.1 p.2 = f p
  rw [entries_ofFinite]
  by_cases hi : p.1 < n
  · by_cases hj : p.2 < n
    · rw [dite_eq_left hi, dite_eq_left hj]
      rfl
    · rw [dite_eq_left hi, dite_eq_right hj]
      symm
      by_contra hp
      have hmem : p ∈ f.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hp
      have hsup := Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => max p.1 p.2) hmem
      have hmax := Nat.le_max_right p.1 p.2
      have hj' : p.2 < n := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hmax.trans hsup)
      exact hj hj'
  · rw [dite_eq_right hi]
    symm
    by_contra hp
    have hmem : p ∈ f.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hp
    have hsup := Finset.le_sup (f := fun p : ℕ × ℕ => max p.1 p.2) hmem
    have hmax := Nat.le_max_left p.1 p.2
    have hi' : p.1 < n := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hmax.trans hsup)
    exact hi hi'

/-- The finite-support realization preserves the actual native ground-module structure. -/
def toFinsuppLinear : StableModule k A →ₗ[k] (ℕ × ℕ) →₀ A where
  toFun := toFinsupp k A
  map_add' x y := by
    refine DirectLimit.induction₂ _ (fun n B C => ?_) x y
    change toFinsupp k A (ofFinite k A n B + ofFinite k A n C) =
      toFinsupp k A (ofFinite k A n B) + toFinsupp k A (ofFinite k A n C)
    rw [← map_add]
    ext p
    by_cases hi : p.1 < n <;> by_cases hj : p.2 < n <;>
      simp only [toFinsupp_apply, entries_ofFinite, hi, hj, ↓reduceDIte,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Matrix.add_apply, zero_add]
  map_smul' c x := by
    refine DirectLimit.induction _ (fun n B => ?_) x
    change toFinsupp k A (c • ofFinite k A n B) = c • toFinsupp k A (ofFinite k A n B)
    rw [← map_smul]
    ext p
    by_cases hi : p.1 < n <;> by_cases hj : p.2 < n <;>
      simp only [toFinsupp_apply, entries_ofFinite, hi, hj, ↓reduceDIte,
        Finsupp.smul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_zero]

/-- An earned ground-linear equivalence with the literal finite-support matrix coordinates. -/
def finsuppEquiv : StableModule k A ≃ₗ[k] (ℕ × ℕ) →₀ A :=
  { toFinsuppLinear k A,
    Equiv.ofBijective (toFinsupp k A)
      ⟨toFinsupp_injective k A, toFinsupp_surjective k A⟩ with }

@[simp]
theorem finsuppEquiv_apply (x : StableModule k A) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    finsuppEquiv k A x p = entries k A x p.1 p.2 := rfl

end StableModule

end Matrix

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.StableModule
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi

/-!
# Linear retraction to an actual finite matrix stage

Natural-number finite-support coordinates restrict to a finite square. This
is a ground-linear retraction of the stage inclusion. It is not claimed to be
an algebra map or a chain map.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace Matrix.StableModule

variable (k : Type u) [Semiring k] (M : Type v) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M]

/-- Actual finite-square projection of the native coefficient direct limit. -/
def truncate (r : ℕ) : Matrix.StableModule k M →ₗ[k] Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) M :=
  (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin r => LinearMap.pi fun j : Fin r =>
    Finsupp.lapply (i.val, j.val)).comp (finsuppEquiv k M).toLinearMap

@[simp]
theorem truncate_apply (r : ℕ) (X : Matrix.StableModule k M) (i j : Fin r) :
    truncate k M r X i j = entries k M X i.val j.val := rfl

/-- The finite-square projection is a retraction of the actual stage inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem truncate_ofFinite (r : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) M) :
    truncate k M r (ofFinite k M r X) = X := by
  ext i j
  exact entries_ofFinite_fin k M r X i j

theorem truncate_comp_ofFinite (r : ℕ) :
    (truncate k M r).comp (ofFinite k M r) = LinearMap.id := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro X
  exact truncate_ofFinite k M r X

end Matrix.StableModule

Author: @toskua

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.FiniteDimensional
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
# Rank classification of finite complex star projections

A finite complex star projection admits an orthonormal frame for its range.
The associated rectangular matrix has identity Gram matrix and reconstructs
the projection.  Consequently two square star projections, possibly in
different matrix sizes, are rectangularly Murray--von Neumann equivalent
exactly when their matrix ranks agree.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace Matrix

namespace Matrix

noncomputable section

variable {n m : ℕ}

private theorem cStarMatrix_mul_assoc
    {l m n k : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : CStarMatrix l m ℂ) (B : CStarMatrix m n ℂ)
    (C : CStarMatrix n k ℂ) :
    (A * B) * C = A * (B * C) :=
  Matrix.mul_assoc A B C

private theorem cStarMatrix_one_mul
    {l m : Type*} [Fintype l] [DecidableEq l]
    (A : CStarMatrix l m ℂ) :
    (1 : CStarMatrix l l ℂ) * A = A := by
  apply CStarMatrix.ext
  intro i j
  simp [CStarMatrix.mul_apply, CStarMatrix.one_apply]

/-- A rank-indexed orthonormal basis for the range of a finite complex
matrix, regarded as an operator on Euclidean space. -/
noncomputable def starProjectionRangeBasis
    (P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    OrthonormalBasis
      (Fin (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) ℂ
      (LinearMap.range
        (Matrix.toLin
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
          (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) := by
  let M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ := CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P
  let T := Matrix.toLin
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis M
  have hrank :
      Module.finrank ℂ (LinearMap.range T) = Matrix.rank M := by
    symm
    exact (Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin M
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis)
  exact (stdOrthonormalBasis ℂ (LinearMap.range T)).reindex
    (finCongr hrank)

/-- The isometric inclusion of rank coordinates into the range of a finite
complex matrix. -/
noncomputable def starProjectionRangeIsometry
    (P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ
        (Fin (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) →ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) :=
  (LinearMap.range
      (Matrix.toLin
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
        (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))).subtypeₗᵢ.comp
    (starProjectionRangeBasis P).repr.symm.toLinearIsometry

private theorem starProjectionRangeIsometry_range
    (P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    LinearMap.range (starProjectionRangeIsometry P).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.range
        (Matrix.toLin
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
          (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ((starProjectionRangeBasis P).repr.symm x).property
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨(starProjectionRangeBasis P).repr ⟨y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
    change
      (((starProjectionRangeBasis P).repr.symm
        ((starProjectionRangeBasis P).repr ⟨y, hy⟩) :
          LinearMap.range
            (Matrix.toLin
              (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
              (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
              (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) :
        EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) = y
    rw [(starProjectionRangeBasis P).repr.symm_apply_apply]

/-- The rectangular matrix whose columns form an orthonormal basis of the
range of a finite complex matrix. -/
noncomputable def starProjectionRangeFrame
    (P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    CStarMatrix (Fin n)
      (Fin (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) ℂ :=
  CStarMatrix.ofMatrix <|
    LinearMap.toMatrix
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun
        (Fin (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) ℂ).toBasis
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ).toBasis
      (starProjectionRangeIsometry P).toLinearMap

/-- The columns of `starProjectionRangeFrame` are orthonormal. -/
@[simp]
theorem starProjectionRangeFrame_conjTranspose_mul_self
    (P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    CStarMatrix.conjTranspose (starProjectionRangeFrame P) *
        starProjectionRangeFrame P = 1 := by
  let br := EuclideanSpace.basisFun
    (Fin (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) ℂ
  let bn := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ
  let L := starProjectionRangeIsometry P
  change
    (LinearMap.toMatrix br.toBasis bn.toBasis L.toLinearMap)ᴴ *
        LinearMap.toMatrix br.toBasis bn.toBasis L.toLinearMap = 1
  rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_adjoint br bn L.toLinearMap]
  rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_comp br.toBasis bn.toBasis br.toBasis]
  rw [L.adjoint_comp_self']
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix_id br.toBasis

/-- For a star projection, its range frame reconstructs the projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem IsStarProjection.starProjectionRangeFrame_mul_conjTranspose
    {P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hP : IsStarProjection P) :
    starProjectionRangeFrame P *
        CStarMatrix.conjTranspose (starProjectionRangeFrame P) = P := by
  let M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ := CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P
  let bn := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℂ
  let br := EuclideanSpace.basisFun
    (Fin (Matrix.rank M)) ℂ
  let T := Matrix.toLin bn.toBasis bn.toBasis M
  let L := starProjectionRangeIsometry P
  let S : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n) :=
    L.toLinearMap.comp L.toLinearMap.adjoint
  have hM : IsStarProjection M := hP
  have hTstar : IsStarProjection T := by
    change IsStarProjection ((LinearMap.toMatrixOrthonormal bn).symm M)
    exact hM.map (LinearMap.toMatrixOrthonormal bn).symm
  have hT : T.IsSymmetricProjection :=
    LinearMap.isStarProjection_iff_isSymmetricProjection.mp hTstar
  have hS : S.IsSymmetricProjection := {
    isIdempotentElem := by
      rw [IsIdempotentElem]
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      change L.toLinearMap
          (L.toLinearMap.adjoint
            (L.toLinearMap (L.toLinearMap.adjoint x))) =
        L.toLinearMap (L.toLinearMap.adjoint x)
      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun L.adjoint_comp_self'
        (L.toLinearMap.adjoint x)
      exact congrArg L.toLinearMap h
    isSymmetric := by
      exact LinearMap.isSymmetric_self_comp_adjoint L.toLinearMap }
  have hST : S = T := by
    apply hS.ext hT
    rw [LinearMap.range_self_comp_adjoint]
    exact starProjectionRangeIsometry_range P
  change
    LinearMap.toMatrix br.toBasis bn.toBasis L.toLinearMap *
        (LinearMap.toMatrix br.toBasis bn.toBasis L.toLinearMap)ᴴ = M
  rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_adjoint br bn L.toLinearMap]
  rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_comp bn.toBasis br.toBasis bn.toBasis]
  rw [show L.toLinearMap.comp L.toLinearMap.adjoint = T from hST]
  simp [T, M]

/-- A complex star projection has a rectangular orthonormal range frame. -/
theorem IsStarProjection.exists_rangeFrame
    {P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hP : IsStarProjection P) :
    ∃ E : CStarMatrix (Fin n)
        (Fin (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P))) ℂ,
      CStarMatrix.conjTranspose E * E = 1 ∧
        E * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose E = P :=
  ⟨starProjectionRangeFrame P,
    starProjectionRangeFrame_conjTranspose_mul_self P,
    Matrix.IsStarProjection.starProjectionRangeFrame_mul_conjTranspose hP⟩

/-- A complex star projection has a range frame at any prescribed index size
equal to its rank. -/
theorem IsStarProjection.exists_rangeFrame_of_rank_eq
    {P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hP : IsStarProjection P)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P) = r) :
    ∃ E : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℂ,
      CStarMatrix.conjTranspose E * E = 1 ∧
        E * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose E = P := by
  subst r
  exact Matrix.IsStarProjection.exists_rangeFrame hP

/-- A rectangular partial-isometry witness forces equality of the two square
matrix ranks. -/
theorem rank_eq_of_rectangular_partialIsometry
    {P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    {Q : CStarMatrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    {U : CStarMatrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hP : P = CStarMatrix.conjTranspose U * U)
    (hQ : Q = U * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose U) :
    Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P) =
      Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm Q) := by
  rw [hP, hQ]
  exact (Matrix.rank_conjTranspose_mul_self
    (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm U)).trans
      (Matrix.rank_self_mul_conjTranspose
        (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm U)).symm

/-- Two finite complex square star projections are rectangularly
Murray--von Neumann equivalent exactly when their ranks agree. -/
theorem isStarProjection_rectangularEquiv_iff_rank_eq
    {P : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    {Q : CStarMatrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ}
    (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q) :
    (∃ U : CStarMatrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ,
        P = CStarMatrix.conjTranspose U * U ∧
          Q = U * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose U) ↔
      Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P) =
        Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm Q) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hPU, hQU⟩
    exact rank_eq_of_rectangular_partialIsometry hPU hQU
  · intro hrank
    obtain ⟨EP, hEPGram, hEPRange⟩ :=
      Matrix.IsStarProjection.exists_rangeFrame hP
    obtain ⟨EQ, hEQGram, hEQRange⟩ :=
      Matrix.IsStarProjection.exists_rangeFrame_of_rank_eq hQ
        (Matrix.rank (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm P)) hrank.symm
    refine ⟨EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show CStarMatrix.conjTranspose
          (EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP) =
            EP * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ by
        apply CStarMatrix.ext
        intro i j
        simp [CStarMatrix.conjTranspose_apply, CStarMatrix.mul_apply,
          star_sum, star_mul]]
      symm
      calc
        (EP * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ) *
            (EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP) =
          EP * (CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ *
            (EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP)) :=
          cStarMatrix_mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = EP * ((CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ * EQ) *
            CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP) :=
          congrArg (fun X ↦ EP * X)
            (cStarMatrix_mul_assoc
              (CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ) EQ
              (CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP)).symm
        _ = EP * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP := by
          rw [hEQGram, cStarMatrix_one_mul]
        _ = P := hEPRange
    · rw [show CStarMatrix.conjTranspose
          (EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP) =
            EP * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ by
        apply CStarMatrix.ext
        intro i j
        simp [CStarMatrix.conjTranspose_apply, CStarMatrix.mul_apply,
          star_sum, star_mul]]
      symm
      calc
        (EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP) *
            (EP * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ) =
          EQ * (CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP *
            (EP * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ)) :=
          cStarMatrix_mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = EQ * ((CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP * EP) *
            CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ) :=
          congrArg (fun X ↦ EQ * X)
            (cStarMatrix_mul_assoc
              (CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EP) EP
              (CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ)).symm
        _ = EQ * CStarMatrix.conjTranspose EQ := by
          rw [hEPGram, cStarMatrix_one_mul]
        _ = Q := hEQRange

end


end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.Basic.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup

import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.FinTwoHadamard
import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.UnitaryBlockDiagonal
import MathlibExt.Logic.Equiv.TwoPointSumCompl

/-!
# Two-level Hadamard unitary

This file defines the two-level Hadamard matrix that acts as the
normalized `Fin 2` Hadamard block on two distinct indices `a` and `b`
and as the identity elsewhere. It proves unitary membership by
block-diagonal transport and reindexing.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix

/-- Two-level Hadamard matrix with Hadamard block on `a`, `b`. -/
noncomputable def twoLevelHadamard {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (a b : n) :
    Matrix n n Complex :=
  fun i j =>
    if i = a then
      if j = a then ((1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2 : Complex)
      else if j = b then ((1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2 : Complex)
      else 0
    else if i = b then
      if j = a then ((1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2 : Complex)
      else if j = b then ((-1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2 : Complex)
      else 0
    else if i = j then 1 else 0

private noncomputable def twoLevelBlock {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (a b : n) :
    Matrix (Fin 2 ⊕ {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b})
      (Fin 2 ⊕ {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b}) Complex :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks finTwoHadamard 0 0
    (1 : Matrix {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b} {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b} Complex)

private lemma one_mem_compl {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (a b : n) :
    (1 : Matrix {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b} {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b} Complex) ∈
      Matrix.unitaryGroup _ Complex := by
  rw [Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff]
  simp

private lemma twoLevelBlock_mem {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (a b : n) :
    twoLevelBlock (n := n) a b ∈
      Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin 2 ⊕ {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b}) Complex := by
  unfold twoLevelBlock
  exact fromBlocks_diagonal_mem_unitaryGroup finTwoHadamard_mem_unitaryGroup
    (one_mem_compl a b)

private theorem reindex_twoLevelBlock_eq {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (a b : n)
    (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab)
        (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab) (twoLevelBlock a b) =
      twoLevelHadamard a b := by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  unfold twoLevelBlock twoLevelHadamard
  by_cases hia : i = a
  · have hsym_i : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm i = Sum.inl 0 := by
      rw [hia, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_first]
    rw [hsym_i]
    by_cases hja : j = a
    · have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j = Sum.inl 0 := by
        rw [hja, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_first]
      rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
      rw [ite_eq_left hia, ite_eq_left hja]
      simp [finTwoHadamard]
    · by_cases hjb : j = b
      · have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j = Sum.inl 1 := by
          rw [hjb, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_second]
        rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
        rw [ite_eq_left hia, ite_eq_right hja, ite_eq_left hjb]
        simp [finTwoHadamard]
      · have hj1 : j ≠ a := hja
        have hj2 : j ≠ b := hjb
        have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j =
            Sum.inr ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ := by
          rw [Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_other _ _ _ _ hj1 hj2]
        rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂]
        rw [ite_eq_left hia, ite_eq_right hja, ite_eq_right hjb]
        simp
  · by_cases hib : i = b
    · have hsym_i : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm i = Sum.inl 1 := by
        rw [hib, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_second]
      rw [hsym_i]
      by_cases hja : j = a
      · have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j = Sum.inl 0 := by
          rw [hja, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_first]
        rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
        rw [ite_eq_right hia, ite_eq_left hib, ite_eq_left hja]
        simp [finTwoHadamard]
      · by_cases hjb : j = b
        · have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j = Sum.inl 1 := by
            rw [hjb, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_second]
          rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
          rw [ite_eq_right hia, ite_eq_left hib, ite_eq_right hja, ite_eq_left hjb]
          simp [finTwoHadamard]
        · have hj1 : j ≠ a := hja
          have hj2 : j ≠ b := hjb
          have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j =
              Sum.inr ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ := by
            rw [Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_other _ _ _ _ hj1 hj2]
          rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂]
          rw [ite_eq_right hia, ite_eq_left hib, ite_eq_right hja, ite_eq_right hjb]
          simp
    · have hi1 : i ≠ a := hia
      have hi2 : i ≠ b := hib
      have hsym_i : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm i =
          Sum.inr ⟨i, hi1, hi2⟩ := by
        rw [Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_other _ _ _ _ hi1 hi2]
      rw [hsym_i]
      by_cases hja : j = a
      · have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j = Sum.inl 0 := by
          rw [hja, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_first]
        rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
        have hij : i ≠ j := by
          intro hij
          rw [hij, hja] at hia
          exact hia rfl
        rw [ite_eq_right hia, ite_eq_right hib, ite_eq_right hij]
        simp
      · by_cases hjb : j = b
        · have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j = Sum.inl 1 := by
            rw [hjb, Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_second]
          rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
          have hij : i ≠ j := by
            intro hij
            rw [hij, hjb] at hib
            exact hib rfl
          rw [ite_eq_right hia, ite_eq_right hib, ite_eq_right hij]
          simp
        · have hj1 : j ≠ a := hja
          have hj2 : j ≠ b := hjb
          have hsym_j : (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab).symm j =
              Sum.inr ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ := by
            rw [Equiv.twoPointSumCompl_symm_apply_other _ _ _ _ hj1 hj2]
          rw [hsym_j, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂]
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · have heq : (⟨i, hi1, hi2⟩ : {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b}) =
                ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ := Subtype.ext hij
            rw [heq]
            rw [ite_eq_right hja, ite_eq_right hjb]
            rw [ite_eq_right hi1, ite_eq_right hi2, ite_eq_left hij]
            simp
          · have hne : (⟨i, hi1, hi2⟩ : {x : n // x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b}) ≠
                ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩ := by
              intro h
              exact hij (congrArg Subtype.val h)
            rw [ite_eq_right hja, ite_eq_right hjb]
            rw [ite_eq_right hi1, ite_eq_right hi2, ite_eq_right hij]
            simp [hne]

/-- Two-level Hadamard is unitary for distinct indices. -/
theorem twoLevelHadamard_mem_unitaryGroup {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (a b : n) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    twoLevelHadamard a b ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n Complex := by
  have hBlock := twoLevelBlock_mem (n := n) a b
  have hRe := reindex_mem_unitaryGroup
    (Equiv.twoPointSumCompl a b hab) hBlock
  have hEq := reindex_twoLevelBlock_eq a b hab
  rw [hEq] at hRe
  exact hRe

/-- Bundled unitary for the two-level Hadamard. -/
noncomputable def twoLevelHadamardUnitary {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (a b : n) (hab : a ≠ b) : Matrix.unitaryGroup n Complex :=
  ⟨twoLevelHadamard a b, twoLevelHadamard_mem_unitaryGroup a b hab⟩

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Reindex
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup

/-!
# Unitary block diagonal and reindexing

This file proves that a block diagonal matrix formed from unitary blocks
is unitary on the sum type, and that reindexing a unitary matrix along
an equivalence remains unitary. These lemmas are generic transport tools
for block-diagonal and reindexed unitary constructions.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix

universe u v w

variable {n : Type u} {m : Type v} {R : Type w}
variable [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
variable [CommRing R] [StarRing R]

/-- Block diagonal of two unitaries is unitary on the sum type. -/
theorem fromBlocks_diagonal_mem_unitaryGroup
    {U : Matrix n n R} {V : Matrix m m R}
    (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n R)
    (hV : V ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup m R) :
    Matrix.fromBlocks U 0 0 V ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup (n ⊕ m) R := by
  rw [Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff] at hU hV ⊢
  have hConj : (Matrix.fromBlocks U 0 0 V)ᴴ =
      Matrix.fromBlocks Uᴴ 0 0 Vᴴ := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_conjTranspose]
    simp
  have hStar : star (Matrix.fromBlocks U 0 0 V) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (star U) 0 0 (star V) := by
    calc star (Matrix.fromBlocks U 0 0 V)
        = (Matrix.fromBlocks U 0 0 V)ᴴ := rfl
      _ = Matrix.fromBlocks Uᴴ 0 0 Vᴴ := hConj
      _ = Matrix.fromBlocks (star U) 0 0 (star V) := rfl
  rw [hStar, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
    add_zero, zero_add]
  rw [hU, hV, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]

/-- Reindexing a unitary matrix along an equivalence preserves unitarity. -/
theorem reindex_mem_unitaryGroup (e : n ≃ m)
    {U : Matrix n n R} (hU : U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup n R) :
    Matrix.reindex e e U ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup m R := by
  rw [Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff] at hU ⊢
  have hConj : (Matrix.reindex e e U)ᴴ =
      Matrix.reindex e e Uᴴ :=
    Matrix.conjTranspose_reindex e e U
  have hStar : star (Matrix.reindex e e U) =
      Matrix.reindex e e (star U) := by
    calc star (Matrix.reindex e e U)
        = (Matrix.reindex e e U)ᴴ := rfl
      _ = Matrix.reindex e e Uᴴ := hConj
      _ = Matrix.reindex e e (star U) := rfl
  rw [hStar]
  have hMul : Matrix.reindex e e U *
      Matrix.reindex e e (star U) =
      Matrix.reindex e e (U * star U) := by
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply]
    rw [← Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv (e₂ := e.symm)]
  rw [hMul, hU]
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]

end Matrix

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Order
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace

/-!
# Unitary conjugation of matrices

This module defines conjugation of a square complex matrix by a unitary:

`U * A * Uᴴ` (i.e. `U * A * star U`), and establishes its basic laws: unfolding
to `U * A * star U`, preservation of positive semidefiniteness and trace,
identity and composition, and linearity with respect to addition, negation,
scalar multiplication, subtraction, and finite sums.

## Main definitions

* `Matrix.unitaryConj` – conjugation `U * A * star U`.

## Main results

* `unitaryConj_posSemidef` – PSD is preserved.
* `unitaryConj_trace` – trace is preserved.
* `unitaryConj_one` / `unitaryConj_mul` – identity and composition.
* `unitaryConj_zero`, `unitaryConj_add`, `unitaryConj_smul`, `unitaryConj_neg`,
  `unitaryConj_sub`, `unitaryConj_sum` – linearity and finite sums.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Matrix Finset
open scoped ComplexOrder

namespace Matrix

variable {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

/-- Unitary conjugation of a square matrix: `U * A * Uᴴ`. -/
def unitaryConj (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ :=
  (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)

@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_def (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U A = (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) :=
  rfl

/-- Conjugation by a unitary preserves positive semidefiniteness,
via the pinned API `PosSemidef.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same`. -/
theorem unitaryConj_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) : (unitaryConj U A).PosSemidef := by
  simp only [unitaryConj_def]
  exact hA.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (U : Matrix n n ℂ)

/-- Conjugation by a unitary preserves trace, by cyclicity and
`star U * U = 1`. -/
theorem unitaryConj_trace (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (unitaryConj U A).trace = A.trace := by
  have hUU : star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 :=
    UnitaryGroup.star_mul_self U
  calc
    (unitaryConj U A).trace = ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)).trace :=
      rfl
    _ = (A * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ)).trace := by
      rw [trace_mul_cycle _ _ _, trace_mul_cycle _ _ _]
    _ = (A * (star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (U : Matrix n n ℂ))).trace := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (A * 1).trace := by rw [hUU]
    _ = A.trace := by simp

@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_one (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : unitaryConj 1 A = A := by
  simp [unitaryConj]

theorem unitaryConj_mul (U V : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj (U * V) A = unitaryConj U (unitaryConj V A) := by
  simp only [unitaryConj_def, UnitaryGroup.mul_val, star_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

/-- Unitary conjugation sends `0` to `0`. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_zero (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U (0 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 0 := by
  simp [unitaryConj]

/-- Unitary conjugation distributes over addition. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_add (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U (A + B) = unitaryConj U A + unitaryConj U B := by
  simp [unitaryConj_def, mul_add, add_mul]

/-- Unitary conjugation commutes with scalar action. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_smul {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R ℂ]
    [SMulCommClass R ℂ ℂ] [IsScalarTower R ℂ ℂ]
    (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (c : R) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U (c • A) = c • unitaryConj U A := by
  simp only [unitaryConj_def]
  calc (U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (c • A) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
      = ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * (c • A)) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (c • ((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A)) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ) := by rw [Matrix.mul_smul]
    _ = c • (((U : Matrix n n ℂ) * A) * star (U : Matrix n n ℂ)) := by rw [smul_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

/-- Unitary conjugation sends negation to negation. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_neg (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U (-A) = - unitaryConj U A := by
  simp [unitaryConj_def, neg_mul, mul_neg]

/-- Unitary conjugation distributes over subtraction. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConj_sub (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (A B : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U (A - B) = unitaryConj U A - unitaryConj U B := by
  simp [unitaryConj_def, mul_sub, sub_mul]

variable {ι : Type*}

/-- Unitary conjugation distributes over finite sums. -/
theorem unitaryConj_sum (U : unitaryGroup n ℂ) (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) :
    unitaryConj U (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, unitaryConj U (f i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty, unitaryConj_zero]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha, unitaryConj_add, ih]

end Matrix
